decisions.choice: the seventh month, the twenty-first day: mid-October 520 BC, the last day of the Festival of Booths
decisions.reason: The date is about 17 October 520 BC, less than a month after the work began (1:15). The Festival of Booths ran from the fifteenth to the twenty-first of the seventh month (Leviticus 23:34-36, 39-43). At that festival Solomon had dedicated the first temple (1 Kings 8:2), so the comparison in verse 3 with the house in its former glory would be on everyone's mind. The harvest being celebrated was a poor one (1:10-11). |

decisions.choice: no year is given: it is the year of 1:15
decisions.reason: The verse gives the month and the day but not the year. The second year of Darius, at the end of 1:15, is meant; some read those words as the beginning of this verse (see the note at 1:15). |

decisions.choice: the Hebrew form of the date at every level

decisions.choice: the date and heading as in 1:1: ordinal month and day, with [ወር] and [ቀን] in brackets at Literal where the Hebrew leaves them out; "{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ... መጣ" (L, B), "... መልእክት ሰጠ" (R)
decisions.reason: Haggai's four dates (1:1, 15; 2:1, 10, 20) keep one Hebrew form so they read as one series; Readable says "of the year" as the English does.

fr.B: Qui parmi vous est encore là, qui a vu cette maison dans sa gloire d’autrefois ? Et comment la voyez-vous maintenant ? Ne vous semble-t-elle pas n’être rien du tout ?
fr.R: Qui parmi vous est assez âgé pour avoir vu ce temple dans sa gloire d’autrefois ? À quoi ressemble-t-il pour vous maintenant ? Ne vous semble-t-il pas n’être plus rien ?

es.L: ¿Quién entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ha quedado que vio esta casa en su gloria primera? ¿Y cómo la {{plural_you:ven|veis}} ahora? ¿No es como nada a {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}}?
es.B: ¿Quién de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} queda todavía que haya visto esta casa en su gloria de antes? ¿Y cómo la {{plural_you:ven|veis}} ahora? ¿No {{plural_you:les|os}} parece que no es nada?
es.R: ¿Quién de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} es tan mayor que vio este templo en su gloria de antes? ¿Cómo lo {{plural_you:ven|veis}} ahora? ¿No parece que no es nada?

sw.L: Ni nani kati yenu aliyebaki aliyeiona nyumba hii katika utukufu wake wa kwanza? Nanyi mnaionaje sasa? Je, si kama si kitu machoni penu?
sw.B: Ni nani kati yenu ambaye bado yupo aliyeiona nyumba hii katika utukufu wake wa zamani? Nanyi mnaionaje sasa? Je, haionekani kwenu kama si kitu kabisa?
sw.R: Ni nani kati yenu aliye mzee wa kutosha kuliona hekalu hili katika utukufu wake wa zamani? Linaonekanaje kwenu sasa? Je, halionekani kama si kitu kabisa?

vi.L: Ai trong các ngươi còn sót lại đã thấy nhà này trong vinh quang ban đầu của nó? Và bây giờ các ngươi thấy nó thế nào? Chẳng phải trong mắt các ngươi nó như không có gì sao?
vi.B: Trong các ngươi còn ai đã từng thấy nhà này trong vinh quang thuở trước? Bây giờ các ngươi thấy nó ra sao? Chẳng phải trong mắt các ngươi nó chẳng ra gì sao?
vi.R: Trong các ngươi có ai đủ lớn tuổi để đã thấy đền thờ này trong vinh quang thuở trước không? Bây giờ các ngươi thấy nó thế nào? Chẳng phải nó dường như chẳng ra gì sao?

ko.L: 너희 가운데 남아 있는 자로서 처음 영광 가운데 있던 이 집을 본 자가 누구냐? 그런데 지금 너희는 이것을 어떻게 보느냐? 너희 눈에는 이것이 아무것도 아닌 것 같지 않으냐?
ko.B: 너희 가운데 이 집의 옛 영광을 본 사람이 아직 남아 있느냐? 지금 이 집이 너희에게 어떻게 보이느냐? 너희 눈에는 아무것도 아닌 것처럼 보이지 않느냐?
ko.R: 너희 가운데 옛날 이 성전의 영광을 본 적이 있을 만큼 나이 많은 사람이 누구냐? 지금 이 성전이 너희에게 어떻게 보이느냐? 너희 눈에는 하찮게 보이지 않느냐?

pt.L: Quem entre vocês [é] o que restou, que viu esta casa na sua primeira glória? E como vocês a veem agora? Não é ela como nada aos olhos de vocês?
pt.B: Quem de vocês ainda está aqui e viu esta casa na sua glória de antes? E como vocês a veem agora? Ela não parece nada para vocês?
pt.R: Quem de vocês tem idade para ter visto este templo na sua glória de antes? Como ele parece a vocês agora? Não parece uma coisa sem nenhum valor?

am.L: ይህን ቤት በቀድሞ ክብሩ ያየ ከእናንተ መካከል የቀረ ማን ነው? አሁንስ እንዴት ታዩታላችሁ? በዓይናችሁ እንደ ምንም አይደለምን?
am.B: ከእናንተ መካከል ይህን ቤት በቀድሞ ክብሩ ያየ አሁንም በሕይወት ያለ ማን ነው? አሁንስ እንዴት ታዩታላችሁ? በዓይናችሁ ምንም እንዳልሆነ አይታያችሁምን?
am.R: ከእናንተ መካከል ይህን ቤተ መቅደስ በቀድሞ ክብሩ ለማየት የደረሰ ዕድሜ ያለው ማን ነው? አሁንስ ምን ይመስላችኋል? ምንም እንዳልሆነ አይመስላችሁምን?

hi.L: तुममें से कौन बचा है जिसने इस भवन को उसकी पहली महिमा में देखा था? और अब तुम इसे कैसा देखते हो? क्या यह तुम्हारी आँखों में ना के बराबर नहीं?
hi.B: तुममें से कौन अब तक बचा है जिसने इस भवन को उसकी पहले की महिमा में देखा था? और अब तुम्हें यह कैसा दिखता है? क्या यह तुम्हें ना के बराबर नहीं लगता?
hi.R: तुममें से कौन इतना बूढ़ा है कि उसने इस मन्दिर को उसकी पहले की महिमा में देखा था? अब यह तुम्हें कैसा लगता है? क्या यह तुम्हें बिलकुल तुच्छ नहीं लगता?

ru.L: Кто среди вас остался, кто видел этот дом в его первой славе? И каким вы видите его теперь? Не как ничто ли он в ваших глазах?
ru.B: Кто из вас ещё жив из тех, кто видел этот дом в его прежней славе? И каким вы видите его теперь? Не кажется ли он вам ничем?
ru.R: Кто из вас настолько стар, что видел этот храм в его прежней славе? Каким он кажется вам теперь? Разве он не кажется вам ничем?

ja.L: あなたがたのうち、残っている者で、この家を以前の栄光のうちに見た者はだれか？今、あなたがたはそれをどう見ているか？あなたがたの目には、それは無いに等しいのではないか？
ja.B: あなたがたのうちに、かつての栄光に輝くこの家を見たことのある者が、まだ残っているだろうか？今、この家はあなたがたの目にどう映っているか？まるで無いも同然ではないか？
ja.R: あなたたちの中に、昔の栄光に輝いていたこの神殿を見たことのある年寄りが、まだいるだろうか？今のこの神殿は、どう見えるか？まるで何もないのと同じように見えるではないか？

uk.L: Хто серед вас залишився, хто бачив цей дім у його першій славі? І яким ви бачите його тепер? Хіба він не як ніщо в ваших очах?
uk.B: Хто серед вас ще живий з тих, хто бачив цей дім у його колишній славі? І яким ви бачите його тепер? Хіба він не здається вам зовсім нічим?
uk.R: Хто серед вас такий старий, що бачив цей храм у його колишній славі? Яким він здається вам тепер? Хіба не зовсім нічим?

decisions.choice: who saw this house in its former glory: the oldest people, who remembered Solomon's temple
decisions.reason: The first temple was destroyed in 587 BC, sixty-seven years before. A few of the oldest people could remember it. When the foundation of the new temple was laid, those old men wept aloud, while the younger ones shouted for joy (Ezra 3:12). |

decisions.choice: glory: splendor, honor, weight
decisions.reason: The word means weight, and so honor and splendor. It is used of the beauty of Solomon's temple, and also of the LORD's own presence that filled it (1 Kings 8:11). Haggai uses it of both in verses 7 and 9. |

decisions.choice: as nothing in your eyes: of no account
decisions.reason: Compared with the old temple, the new building looks like nothing at all. The Hebrew says literally "is it not like it, as nothing", that is, "is not such a house as nothing". |

decisions.choice: glory at every level
decisions.reason: "Glory" follows the Isaiah table for this word at every level, here and in verses 7 and 9. Readable says "temple" for "house", as in chapter 1. |

decisions.choice: "gloria" at every level
decisions.reason: Kavod is "gloria" at every level, as the key term, here and in verses 7 and 9.

decisions.choice: a glória (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: kavod is "glória" at every level, here and in verses 7 and 9, as Isaiah has it in Portuguese, so that the splendour of the house and the LORD's own glory (m2) share one word.

decisions.choice: glory "ክብር" at every level (2:3, 7, 9)
decisions.reason: The English keeps glory at every level, and the word ties the old temple's splendour to the glory the LORD promises in 2:7 and 2:9; "ክብር" carries both splendour and honour.

decisions.choice: महिमा at every level
decisions.reason: Glory (kavod) is महिमा, the style guide's key term, here and in verses 7 and 9, where the LORD promises to fill the house with it.

decisions.choice: "слава" at every level
decisions.reason: The same word for the temple's glory here and in verses 7 and 9, so the promise of verse 9 answers this question.

decisions.choice: kavod "栄光" at every level (2:3, 2:7, 2:9).
decisions.reason: Key word of the chapter, kept as one word.

records.literal_gloss: And now, be strong, Zerubbabel, declaration of Yahweh; and be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and be strong, all [the] people of the land, declaration of Yahweh, and work; for I [am] with you, declaration of Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: But now be strong, Zerubbabel, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and be strong, all the people of the land, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and work; for I am with you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: Now be strong, Zerubbabel, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. And be strong, all the people of the land, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and get to work, for I am with you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: But now, Zerubbabel, be strong, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, be strong. Everyone who lives in the land, be strong, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Get to work, because I am with you, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: Mais maintenant sois fort, Zorobabel, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; et sois fort, Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre ; et soyez forts, tout le peuple du pays, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et travaillez ; car je suis avec vous, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: Maintenant, courage, Zorobabel, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Courage, Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre. Courage, vous tous, peuple du pays, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et mettez-vous au travail, car je suis avec vous, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Mais maintenant, Zorobabel, courage, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, grand prêtre, courage. Vous tous qui habitez le pays, courage, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Mettez-vous au travail, car je suis avec vous, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: Pero ahora esfuérzate, Zorobabel, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; y esfuérzate, Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote; y {{plural_you:esfuércense|esforzaos}}, todo el pueblo de la tierra, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y {{plural_you:trabajen|trabajad}}; porque yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: Ahora, esfuérzate, Zorobabel, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Esfuérzate, Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote. Y {{plural_you:esfuércense|esforzaos}}, todo el pueblo de la tierra, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y {{plural_you:pónganse|poneos}} a trabajar, porque yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: Pero ahora, Zorobabel, sé fuerte, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote, sé fuerte. Todos los que viven en el país, {{plural_you:sean fuertes|sed fuertes}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Pónganse|Poneos}} a trabajar, porque yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

sw.L: Lakini sasa uwe hodari, Zerubabeli, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; na uwe hodari, Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu; na mwe hodari, ninyi nyote watu wa nchi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mkafanye kazi; kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niko pamoja nanyi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.B: Sasa uwe hodari, Zerubabeli, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Uwe hodari, Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu. Nanyi mwe hodari, watu wote wa nchi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mkafanye kazi, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niko pamoja nanyi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.R: Lakini sasa, Zerubabeli, uwe hodari, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu, uwe hodari. Kila mtu anayeishi katika nchi hii, uwe hodari, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Fanyeni kazi, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niko pamoja nanyi, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

vi.L: Nhưng bây giờ, hỡi Xô-rô-ba-bên, hãy mạnh mẽ lên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy; hỡi Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, hãy mạnh mẽ lên; hỡi toàn dân trong xứ, hãy mạnh mẽ lên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và hãy làm việc; vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở cùng các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy.
vi.B: Bây giờ, hỡi Xô-rô-ba-bên, hãy mạnh mẽ lên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Hỡi Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, hãy mạnh mẽ lên. Hỡi toàn dân trong xứ, hãy mạnh mẽ lên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và hãy bắt tay vào việc, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở cùng các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy.
vi.R: Nhưng bây giờ, hỡi Xô-rô-ba-bên, hãy mạnh mẽ lên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Hỡi Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, hãy mạnh mẽ lên. Hỡi mọi người sống trong xứ, hãy mạnh mẽ lên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Hãy bắt tay vào việc, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở cùng các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.

ko.L: 그러나 이제 스룹바벨아, 힘을 내어라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아야, 힘을 내어라. 이 땅의 모든 백성아, 힘을 내어라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그리고 일하여라. 내가 너희와 함께 있기 때문이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 이제 스룹바벨아, 힘을 내어라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아야, 힘을 내어라. 이 땅의 모든 백성아, 힘을 내어라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 일을 시작하여라. 내가 너희와 함께 있다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 그러나 이제 스룹바벨아, 힘을 내어라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아야, 힘을 내어라. 이 땅에 사는 모든 사람아, 힘을 내어라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 일을 시작하여라. 내가 너희와 함께 있기 때문이다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Mas agora, sê forte, Zorobabel, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; e sê forte, Josué, filho de Jeozadaque, o sumo sacerdote; e sejam fortes, todo o povo da terra, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e trabalhem; porque eu estou com vocês, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.B: Agora, sê forte, Zorobabel, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Sê forte, Josué, filho de Jeozadaque, o sumo sacerdote. E vocês, todo o povo da terra, sejam fortes, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e ponham mãos à obra, pois eu estou com vocês, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.R: Mas agora, Zorobabel, sê forte, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Josué, filho de Jeozadaque, o sumo sacerdote, sê forte. Todos vocês que moram na terra, sejam fortes, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Mãos à obra, porque eu estou com vocês, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.

am.L: አሁን ግን ዘሩባቤል ሆይ፣ ጠንክር፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ ሊቀ ካህናቱ የኢዮሴዴቅ ልጅ ኢያሱ ሆይ፣ ጠንክር፤ የምድሪቱም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ሆይ፣ ጠንክሩ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ ሥሩም፤ እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝና፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት።
am.B: አሁንም ዘሩባቤል ሆይ፣ ጠንክር፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። ሊቀ ካህናቱ የኢዮሴዴቅ ልጅ ኢያሱ ሆይ፣ ጠንክር። የምድሪቱ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ሆይ፣ ጠንክሩ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ ወደ ሥራም ግቡ፤ እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝና፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: አሁን ግን ዘሩባቤል ሆይ፣ ጠንክር፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። ሊቀ ካህናቱ የኢዮሴዴቅ ልጅ ኢያሱ ሆይ፣ ጠንክር። በምድሪቱ የምትኖሩ ሁሉ፣ ጠንክሩ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። ወደ ሥራ ግቡ፤ እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝና፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: पर अब हे जरुब्बाबेल, बलवंत हो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है; और हे महायाजक यहोसादाक के पुत्र येशूअ, बलवंत हो; और हे देश के सब लोगो, बलवंत हो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, और काम करो; क्योंकि मैं तुम्हारे साथ हूँ, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: अब हे जरुब्बाबेल, बलवंत बनो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है। हे महायाजक यहोसादाक के पुत्र येशूअ, बलवंत बनो। और हे देश के सब लोगो, बलवंत बनो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, और काम में लग जाओ, क्योंकि मैं तुम्हारे साथ हूँ, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: पर अब, हे जरुब्बाबेल, बलवंत बनो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। हे महायाजक यहोसादाक के पुत्र येशूअ, बलवंत बनो। हे देश में रहनेवाले सब लोगो, बलवंत बनो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। काम में लग जाओ, क्योंकि मैं तुम्हारे साथ हूँ, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: А теперь будь силён, Зоровавель, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — и будь силён, Иешуа, сын Иоседека, первосвященник, и будь силён, весь народ земли, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — и работайте; ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} с вами, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Саваофа.
ru.B: А теперь будь силён, Зоровавель, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Будь силён, Иешуа, сын Иоседека, первосвященник. И будь силён, весь народ страны, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — и принимайтесь за работу, потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} с вами, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф.
ru.R: А теперь, Зоровавель, будь сильным, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Иешуа, сын Иоседека, первосвященник, будь сильным. Все, кто живёт в этой стране, будьте сильными, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Принимайтесь за работу, потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} с вами, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств.

ja.L: しかし今、ゼルバベルよ、強くあれ。――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――ヨツァダクの子、大祭司ヨシュアよ、強くあれ。この地のすべての民よ、強くあれ。――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――そして働け。わたしがあなたがたと共にいるからだ。――万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――
ja.B: 今、ゼルバベルよ、強くありなさい、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。ヨツァダクの子で大祭司であるヨシュアよ、強くありなさい。この地のすべての民よ、強くありなさい、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。仕事に取りかかりなさい。わたしがあなたがたと共にいるからだ、と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: しかし今、ゼルバベルよ、強くありなさい、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。ヨツァダクの息子で大祭司のヨシュアよ、強くありなさい。この地に住む人は皆、強くありなさい、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。仕事に取りかかりなさい。わたしがあなたたちと共にいるからだ、と天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

uk.L: Але тепер будь сильним, Зоровавелю, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}; і будь сильним, Єгошуа, сину Єгоцадака, первосвящениче; і будьте сильні, увесь народе землі, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і працюйте; бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} з вами, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот.
uk.B: Тепер будь сильним, Зоровавелю, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Будь сильним, Єгошуа, сину Єгоцадака, первосвящениче. І будьте сильні, увесь народе землі, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і беріться до праці, бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} з вами, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ.
uk.R: Але тепер, Зоровавелю, будь сильним, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Єгошуа, сину Єгоцадака, первосвящениче, будь сильним. Усі, хто живе в цій землі, будьте сильні, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Беріться до праці, бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} з вами, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель.

decisions.choice: be strong ... for I am with you: the words spoken to Joshua son of Nun and to Solomon
decisions.reason: The LORD told Joshua son of Nun, as he took up Moses' work, "Be strong ... for the LORD your God is with you" (Joshua 1:6-9). David told Solomon the same as he gave him the plans for the first temple (1 Chronicles 22:13-16; 28:20). Now a later Joshua, with the heir of David's line, hears the same words for the building of the second temple. |

decisions.choice: all the people of the land: the whole community living in Judah
decisions.reason: Here the phrase means all the people, alongside their leaders (compare 2 Kings 11:14). In Ezra 4:4 a similar phrase is used of the neighbors who opposed the building, but that is not the sense here. |

decisions.choice: work: get to work, act
decisions.reason: The verb means "do, act". After the call to be strong, it means to take up the work on the temple. |

decisions.choice: Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and work (L), get to work (B, R)
decisions.reason: The name keeps the wording of 1:1. Readable puts each name before its call, so that each leader is addressed in turn. |

decisions.choice: "sois fort" (L), "courage" (B, R), singular to each man, then "vous" to the people
decisions.reason: The term sheet's address forms for Haggai: the Hebrew singular to Zerubbabel and to Joshua, plural to the people.

decisions.choice: "esfuérzate" to each leader; plural_you to the people
decisions.reason: God speaks to Zerubbabel and Joshua one by one with "tú", and to the people as a group with plural_you, as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "uwe hodari" to each leader; "mwe hodari" (L, B) to the people
decisions.reason: Swahili marks singular and plural you, so the command is singular to Zerubbabel and Joshua and plural to the people of the land. The free pronoun "mimi" for God takes a deity_pronoun span where the English has none, as it does elsewhere in these books.

decisions.choice: "be strong" is "힘을 내어라" and "I am with you" "내가 너희와 함께 있다" at every level
decisions.reason: The words echo those spoken to Joshua son of Nun and to Solomon; Korean keeps one plain wording so the three calls and the promise stand out, as in 1:13.

decisions.choice: sê forte (to each leader); sejam fortes (to the people); eu estou com vocês
decisions.reason: The charge (m1) echoes Joshua 1:6-9, where the LORD tells Joshua "Sê forte" in Portuguese, so God's "tu" to each leader keeps that wording, and the people as a group are told "sejam fortes". "Eu estou com vocês" repeats 1:13 at each level.

decisions.choice: be strong "ጠንክር" (to one) and "ጠንክሩ" (to the people), as Joshua 1:6-9; work "ሥሩ" (L), "ወደ ሥራ ግቡ" (B, R); I am with you "እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝ", as 1:13
decisions.reason: The meaning decision hears the charge given to Joshua son of Nun and to Solomon, so the verb of Joshua 1 on main is kept, singular to Zerubbabel and Joshua and plural to the people. The LORD speaks to them as "አንተ" and "እናንተ".

decisions.choice: बलवंत हो (L), बलवंत बनो (B, R); काम करो (L), काम में लग जाओ (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Be strong ... and work, for I am with you" echoes the charge to Joshua son of Nun and to Solomon (m1), so it keeps the wording of Joshua 1:6 and 1 Chronicles 28:20 in this translation at each level.

decisions.choice: "будь силён" (L, B); "будь сильным" (R)
decisions.reason: The words spoken to Joshua son of Nun (m1), in the Russian forms of Joshua 1:9, level by level.

decisions.choice: chazaq "強くあれ" (L), "強くありなさい" (B, R), the oracle command forms; the words recall Joshua 1 ("強く、雄々しくありなさい"), but only the first verb is here.
decisions.reason: Prophetic command forms; the allusion is carried by the shared "強く".

records.literal_gloss: [With] the word that I cut with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit standing in your midst. Do not fear.

en.L: [Remember] the word that I made with you when you came out of Egypt, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit is standing in your midst; do not fear.
en.B: This is the promise I made with you when you came out of Egypt, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit still stands among you. Do not be afraid.
en.R: Remember what I promised you when you came out of Egypt. My Spirit is still with you. Do not be afraid.

fr.L: [Souvenez-vous de] la parole que j’ai conclue avec vous quand vous êtes sortis d’Égypte, et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit se tient au milieu de vous ; ne craignez pas.
fr.B: Telle est la promesse que j’ai faite avec vous quand vous êtes sortis d’Égypte, et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit demeure au milieu de vous. N’ayez pas peur.
fr.R: Souvenez-vous de ce que je vous ai promis quand vous êtes sortis d’Égypte. Mon Esprit est toujours avec vous. N’ayez pas peur.

es.B: Esta es la promesa que hice con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} cuando {{plural_you:salieron|salisteis}} de Egipto, y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu sigue en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} prometí cuando {{plural_you:salieron|salisteis}} de Egipto. Mi Espíritu sigue con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo.

sw.L: [Kumbukeni] neno nililofanya agano nanyi mlipotoka Misri, na Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} anasimama katikati yenu; msiogope.
sw.B: Hii ndiyo ahadi niliyofanya nanyi mlipotoka Misri, na Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} bado yuko kati yenu. Msiogope.
sw.R: Kumbukeni nilichowaahidi mlipotoka Misri. Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} bado yuko pamoja nanyi. Msiogope.

vi.L: [Hãy nhớ] lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập với các ngươi khi các ngươi ra khỏi Ai Cập, và Thần Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang ở giữa các ngươi; đừng sợ.

vi.R: Hãy nhớ điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hứa với các ngươi khi các ngươi ra khỏi Ai Cập. Thần Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vẫn ở với các ngươi. Đừng sợ.

ko.L: 너희가 이집트에서 나올 때에 내가 너희와 맺은 말씀[을 기억하여라]. 내 영이 너희 가운데 머물러 있다. 두려워하지 마라.
ko.B: 이것은 너희가 이집트에서 나올 때에 내가 너희와 맺은 약속이다. 내 영이 지금도 너희 가운데 머물러 있다. 두려워하지 마라.
ko.R: 너희가 이집트에서 나올 때 내가 너희에게 한 약속을 기억하여라. 내 영이 지금도 너희와 함께 있다. 두려워하지 마라.

pt.L: [Lembrem] a palavra que firmei com vocês quando saíram do Egito, e o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito está no meio de vocês; não temam.
pt.B: Esta é a promessa que fiz a vocês quando saíram do Egito, e o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito continua no meio de vocês. Não tenham medo.
pt.R: Lembrem-se do que prometi a vocês quando saíram do Egito. O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito continua com vocês. Não tenham medo.

hi.L: [स्मरण करो] उस वचन को जो मैंने तुम्हारे साथ बाँधा जब तुम मिस्र से निकले, और मेरा आत्मा तुम्हारे बीच खड़ा है; मत डरो।
hi.B: यही वह प्रतिज्ञा है जो मैंने तुम्हारे साथ बाँधी थी जब तुम मिस्र से निकले थे, और मेरा आत्मा अब भी तुम्हारे बीच बना है। मत डरो।

ru.L: [Помните] слово, которое {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} заключил с вами, когда вы выходили из Египта, и {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Дух пребывает среди вас; не бойтесь.
ru.B: Таково обещание, которое {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дал вам, когда вы вышли из Египта, и {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Дух по-прежнему среди вас. Не бойтесь.
ru.R: Помните, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} обещал вам, когда вы вышли из Египта. Мой Дух по-прежнему с вами. Не бойтесь.

ja.L: あなたがたがエジプトから出て来たときに、わたしがあなたがたと結んだ言葉[を覚えよ]。わたしの霊は、あなたがたのただ中に立っている。恐れるな。
ja.B: これは、あなたがたがエジプトから出て来たとき、わたしがあなたがたと結んだ約束である。わたしの霊は今も、あなたがたの間にとどまっている。恐れてはならない。
ja.R: あなたたちがエジプトから出て来たとき、わたしが約束したことを思い出しなさい。わたしの霊は、今もあなたたちと共にいる。恐れてはいけない。

uk.L: [Памʼятайте] слово, яке {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} уклав з вами, коли ви вийшли з Єгипту, і {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Дух стоїть посеред вас; не бійтеся.
uk.B: Це обіцянка, яку {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дав вам, коли ви вийшли з Єгипту, і {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Дух і далі перебуває серед вас. Не бійтеся.
uk.R: Памʼятайте, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} пообіцяв вам, коли ви вийшли з Єгипту. Мій Дух і досі з вами. Не бійтеся.

decisions.choice: the word that I made with you: a sentence with no main verb
alternatives: as the word I made with you
keep the word I made with you
decisions.reason: The verse begins with the sign of a direct object, but no verb comes before it. It may be read with "I am with you" in verse 4 ("according to the word I made with you"), or with a verb understood, such as "remember" or "this is". The Greek translation is generally said to lack the first half of the verse. The sense is plain: the LORD's covenant promise from the exodus still holds.

decisions.choice: made: literally "cut", the verb used for making a covenant
decisions.reason: A covenant was "cut" (Genesis 15:10, 18), because animals were cut in two when it was sealed. The word here is the promise of that covenant: "I will be your God, and you will be my people" (Exodus 6:7; Leviticus 26:12). |

decisions.choice: my Spirit standing in your midst: the LORD's Spirit present with his people
decisions.reason: When Israel came out of Egypt, the LORD put his Spirit among them and led them (Isaiah 63:11-14; Numbers 11:17, 25; Nehemiah 9:20). The same Spirit is with the builders. Zechariah, preaching at the same time, says the temple will be built "not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit" (Zechariah 4:6). |

decisions.choice: [Remember] (L), This is (B), Remember (R); Spirit with a capital S
decisions.reason: Each level supplies a verb so that the sentence can be read (m1); Literal brackets it. God's Spirit is written with a capital S, as in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: "[Recuerden]" (L), "Esta es" (B), "Recuerden" (R); "Espíritu" capitalized
decisions.reason: The verse opens with no verb in Hebrew; Spanish supplies one as the English does, with plural_you, and the bracketed verb at L carries the span. God's Spirit is capitalized, as the term sheet sets.

decisions.choice: "Roho wangu", capital R, with personal agreement ("yuko")
decisions.reason: God's Spirit is "Roho" with a capital, as the term sheet sets for ruach of God; "wangu" is a free possessive and takes the span.

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh của Ta" for "my Spirit"
decisions.reason: The terms note: the Spirit of God in the Old Testament is "Thần Linh", capitalised, as in Isaiah 44:3.

decisions.choice: "my Spirit" is "내 영" at every level, with no -시- in God's own mouth
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording: God's Spirit in the prophets is "영", and "성령" stays for the New Testament. Elsewhere, when others speak of the Spirit, it takes -시-.

decisions.choice: firmei (L)
decisions.reason: The verb used for making a covenant (m2) is "firmar", the Portuguese verb for making a covenant; the literal "cortar" would not be understood. "Espírito" takes a capital, as in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: the verbless opening "the word that I cut with you" as "... የገባሁትን ቃል [አስቡ]" (L), "... የገባሁት ቃል ይህ ነው" (B), "... ቃል አስታውሱ" (R); "cut" as "ቃል ገባ" (to make a promise)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no main verb (the meaning decision), and the English supplies Remember (L, R) and This is (B); Amharic supplies the same. "Cutting" a word is the Hebrew idiom for making a covenant; Amharic says that with "ቃል ገባ", and a literal "cut" would not be understood.

decisions.choice: [स्मरण करो] (L), यही वह प्रतिज्ञा है (B), स्मरण करो (R); बाँधा (L, B); मेरा आत्मा
decisions.reason: The sentence has no main verb (m1), so each level supplies one, as the English does; Literal brackets it. Hindi बाँधना is the verb for making a covenant (वाचा बाँधना), which keeps the sense of "cut" (m2). The Spirit takes masculine agreement, as the style guide sets.

decisions.choice: "[Помните]" (L); "Таково" (B); "Помните" (R); "Дух" with a capital
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sentence has no main verb (m1); each level supplies one, Literal in brackets. "Заключил" keeps the covenant verb (m2). God's Spirit is capitalised, as in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: karat "結んだ" (L, B), the verb of making a covenant; ruchi "わたしの霊", not "聖霊" (OT rule); prohibition "恐れるな" (L), "恐れてはならない" (B), "恐れてはいけない" (R).
decisions.reason: The verb keeps the covenant sense of "cut"; the Spirit word follows the prophetic conventions.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: Yet once more, in a little while, I am shaking the heavens and the earth and the sea and the dry ground.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: Once more, and soon, I will shake heaven and earth, sea and dry land.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: Soon I will shake the sky and the earth, the sea and the land, one more time.

es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: Pronto haré temblar el cielo y la tierra, el mar y la tierra firme, una vez más.

decisions.choice: once more I will shake the heavens and the earth: quoted in Hebrews 12:26
decisions.reason: Hebrews 12:26-27 quotes this verse in the wording of the Greek translation ("Yet once more I will shake not only the earth but also heaven"). The writer compares the shaking of the earth at Sinai (Exodus 19:18) with a final shaking, and reads "once more" as meaning that what can be shaken will be removed, so that the unshakable kingdom remains. The verse here is translated from the Hebrew. |

decisions.choice: once more, in a little while: soon, and one more time
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is compressed: "yet one, it is a little". "Once more" recalls the earlier shaking of the earth when God came down at Sinai (Exodus 19:18; Judges 5:4-5). "A little while" says that it will be soon.

decisions.choice: shake the heavens and the earth: the LORD's coming to overturn the powers of the world
decisions.reason: The shaking of all creation is the sign of the LORD coming to act (Joel 4:16; Isaiah 13:13). Verse 7 and verses 21-22 show what it means: the nations and their kingdoms are shaken. |

decisions.choice: once more (L, B), one more time (R)
decisions.reason: Every level keeps "once more", which Hebrews takes up (m1). |

decisions.choice: "Una vez más ... haré temblar"
decisions.reason: Hebrews 12:26 quotes this verse; the Spanish keeps the words of the published Hebrews 12:26 ("Una vez más haré temblar") where the Hebrew allows.

decisions.choice: "Còn một lần nữa ... làm rúng động", the words of Hebrews 12:26 in Vietnamese
decisions.reason: Hebrews 12:26 quotes this verse; the shared words are kept so a reader can see the quotation. The Hebrew "heavens and earth, sea and dry land" is kept in full.

decisions.choice: "once more" is "아직 한 번" (L) and "한 번 더" (B, R); "I will shake" is "흔들 것이다"
decisions.reason: Hebrews 12:26 quotes the line as "내가 한 번 더 … 흔들 것이다"; Balanced and Readable share those words, while Literal keeps the Hebrew's "yet once". The Greek of Hebrews puts the earth and heaven in a different order, as the Septuagint does.

decisions.choice: "Bado mara moja tena" (L); "Mara moja zaidi" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Hebrews 12:26 quotes this line; its Swahili has "mara moja zaidi nitatikisa", which B and R share.

decisions.choice: Ainda uma vez ... sacudirei (L); Mais uma vez ... farei tremer (B, R): the words of Hebrews 12:26
alternatives: não só a terra, mas também o céu
decisions.reason: Hebrews 12:26 quotes this verse from the Greek (m1), and its Portuguese is "Ainda uma vez [mais] eu sacudirei" (L) and "Mais uma vez farei tremer" (B, R); each level keeps those words. The rest follows the Hebrew, which Hebrews does not: "daqui a pouco" / "em breve", and the four parts of creation, "os céus, e a terra, e o mar, e a terra firme", in place of Hebrews' "não só a terra, mas também o céu". The same verbs return in verses 7 and 21.

decisions.choice: Hebrews 12:26 quotes this verse: its Amharic "ገና አንድ ጊዜ [ደግሞ]" (L) and "አንድ ጊዜ ደግሞ" (B, R) for "yet once more" and "አናውጣለሁ" for "I will shake" are kept; the heavens "ሰማያት" (L), "ሰማይ" (B, R); the dry land "የብስ"
decisions.reason: Where the Hebrew and the Greek of Hebrews 12:26 agree (yet once, I will shake heaven and earth) the Amharic New Testament's words are kept. Hebrews quotes the Greek in a shorter form; the Hebrew's "in a little while" and "the sea and the dry land", which Hebrews does not quote, are translated from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: एक बार और ... हिला दूँगा (B, R); हिलाने पर हूँ (L); आकाश और पृथ्वी और समुद्र और स्थल
alternatives: मैं केवल पृथ्वी को नहीं, पर आकाश को भी हिला दूँगा
decisions.reason: Hebrews 12:26 quotes this line as "एक बार और मैं केवल पृथ्वी को नहीं, बल्कि आकाश को भी हिला दूँगा", following the Greek Old Testament. Hindi translates the Hebrew, which names heaven, earth, sea and dry land and says "in a little while", and keeps the words Hebrews shares with it: एक बार और (at Literal, as Hebrews' Balanced) and हिला दूँगा. Literal keeps the Hebrew participle, "I am about to shake".

decisions.choice: "Ещё раз ... поколеблю" (L, B), "ещё раз потрясу" (R), with the four parts of the world as the Hebrew has them
alternatives: "не только землю, но и небо", as Hebrews 12:26
decisions.reason: Hebrews 12:26 follows the Greek Old Testament ("not only the earth but also heaven"); this is translated from the Hebrew, which names heavens, earth, sea and dry land. The words Hebrews shares keep its Russian: "Ещё раз" and "поколеблю" (L, B), "потрясу" (R).

decisions.choice: hir'ish "揺り動かす" (2:6, 2:7, 2:21), the verb of the Japanese of Hebrews 12:26, which quotes this verse; drafted from the Hebrew.
decisions.reason: The NT quotation and the source agree on the verb.

records.literal_gloss: And I will shake all the nations, and [the] treasure of all the nations will come, and I will fill this house [with] glory, says Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: And I will shake all the nations, and the treasures of all the nations will come, and I will fill this house full of glory, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: I will shake all the nations, and the wealth of all the nations will come in. I will fill this house with glory, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: I will shake all the nations, and their riches will be brought here. I will fill this temple with glory, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: Et j’ébranlerai toutes les nations, et les trésors de toutes les nations viendront, et je remplirai cette maison de gloire, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: J’ébranlerai toutes les nations, et les richesses de toutes les nations afflueront. Je remplirai cette maison de gloire, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Je ferai trembler toutes les nations, et on apportera ici leurs richesses. Je remplirai ce temple de gloire, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: Y haré temblar a todas las naciones, y vendrán los tesoros de todas las naciones, y llenaré esta casa de gloria, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: Haré temblar a todas las naciones, y llegarán las riquezas de todas las naciones. Llenaré esta casa de gloria, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: Haré temblar a todas las naciones, y sus riquezas serán traídas aquí. Llenaré este templo de gloria, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

sw.L: Nami nitayatikisa mataifa yote, na hazina za mataifa yote zitakuja, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaijaza nyumba hii utukufu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.B: Nitayatikisa mataifa yote, na mali ya mataifa yote itaingia. Nitaijaza nyumba hii utukufu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.R: Nitayatikisa mataifa yote, na utajiri wao utaletwa hapa. Nitalijaza hekalu hili utukufu, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

vi.L: Ta sẽ làm rúng động mọi nước, và các báu vật của mọi nước sẽ đến, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho nhà này đầy vinh quang, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.
vi.B: Ta sẽ làm rúng động mọi nước, và của cải của mọi nước sẽ được đem đến. Ta sẽ làm cho nhà này đầy vinh quang, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm rúng động mọi nước, và của cải của chúng sẽ được đem đến đây. Ta sẽ làm cho đền thờ này đầy vinh quang, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.

ko.L: 내가 모든 민족을 흔들 것이니, 모든 민족의 보물이 올 것이다. 내가 이 집을 영광으로 가득 채우겠다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.B: 내가 모든 민족을 흔들 것이니, 모든 민족의 재물이 이리로 들어올 것이다. 내가 이 집을 영광으로 가득 채우겠다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 내가 모든 민족을 흔들어 그들의 재물이 이리로 들어오게 하겠다. 내가 이 성전을 영광으로 가득 채우겠다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: E sacudirei todas as nações, e virão os tesouros de todas as nações, e encherei esta casa de glória, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.B: Farei tremer todas as nações, e as riquezas de todas as nações virão para cá. Encherei esta casa de glória, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.R: Vou fazer tremer todas as nações, e as riquezas delas vão ser trazidas para cá. Vou encher este templo de glória, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.

am.L: ሕዝቦችንም ሁሉ አናውጣለሁ፤ የሕዝቦችም ሁሉ ውድ ሀብት ይመጣል፤ ይህንም ቤት በክብር እሞላዋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት።
am.B: ሕዝቦችን ሁሉ አናውጣለሁ፤ የሕዝቦችም ሁሉ ሀብት ወደዚህ ይገባል። ይህንም ቤት በክብር እሞላዋለሁ፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ሕዝቦችን ሁሉ አናውጣለሁ፤ ሀብታቸውም ወደዚህ ይመጣል። ይህንም ቤተ መቅደስ በክብር እሞላዋለሁ፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: और मैं सब जातियों को हिला दूँगा, और सब जातियों की मनभावनी वस्तुएँ आएँगी, और मैं इस भवन को महिमा से भर दूँगा, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।
hi.B: मैं सब राष्ट्रों को हिला दूँगा, और सब राष्ट्रों का धन यहाँ आएगा। मैं इस भवन को महिमा से भर दूँगा, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।
hi.R: मैं सब राष्ट्रों को हिला दूँगा, और उनकी धन-संपत्ति यहाँ लाई जाएगी। मैं इस मन्दिर को महिमा से भर दूँगा, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поколеблю все народы, и придут сокровища всех народов, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наполню этот дом славой, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф.
ru.B: Я поколеблю все народы, и придут богатства всех народов. Я наполню этот дом славой, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф.
ru.R: Я потрясу все народы, и их богатства принесут сюда. Я наполню этот храм славой, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств.

ja.L: そしてわたしはすべての国々を揺り動かす。すべての国々の宝が来る。わたしはこの家を栄光で満たす、と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。
ja.B: わたしはすべての国々を揺り動かし、すべての国々の富がここに来る。わたしはこの家を栄光で満たす、と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。
ja.R: わたしはすべての国々を揺り動かす。すると、国々の宝がここに運ばれて来る。わたしはこの神殿を栄光で満たす、と天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

uk.L: І потрясу всі народи, і прийдуть скарби всіх народів, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наповню цей дім славою, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот.
uk.B: Я потрясу всі народи, і прийде багатство всіх народів. Я наповню цей дім славою, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ.
uk.R: Я потрясу всі народи, і їхні багатства принесуть сюди. Я наповню цей храм славою, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель.

decisions.choice: the treasures of all the nations: the valuable things of the nations
decisions.reason: The word means "what is desired, precious". Its verb is plural ("they will come"), so it is usually read as the treasures of the nations, which verse 8 explains: the silver and gold are the LORD's. Isaiah 60:5-11 also pictures the wealth of the nations brought to Zion. The Latin translation reads "the desired one of all nations will come", and from it came the traditional reading "the desire of all nations", taken by many Christians as a title of the Messiah. The Hebrew wording favors the treasures.

decisions.choice: glory: splendor, and the LORD's own presence
decisions.reason: The house will be filled with splendor from the treasures, and also with the LORD's glory, as his glory filled the tabernacle and Solomon's temple (Exodus 40:34-35; 1 Kings 8:10-11). |

decisions.choice: treasures (L), wealth (B), riches (R)
decisions.reason: The levels follow m1. Readable says "will be brought here" for "will come", since treasures do not walk. |

decisions.choice: os tesouros (L); as riquezas (B, R)
alternatives: o Desejado de todas as nações
decisions.reason: The plural verb shows that the precious things of the nations are meant (m1), so Portuguese says "tesouros" and "riquezas". Older Portuguese Bibles read a person here, "o Desejado de todas as nações", following the Latin; the Hebrew does not support it.

decisions.choice: the treasure of the nations "የሕዝቦች ሁሉ ውድ ሀብት" (L), "የሕዝቦች ሁሉ ሀብት" (B), "ሀብታቸው" (R); the nations "ሕዝቦች" at every level
alternatives: "የአሕዛብ ሁሉ ምኞት" (the desire of all nations)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the precious things of the nations, which the plural verb in the Hebrew supports, so the familiar "desire of the nations" is not used. The nations (goyim) are "ሕዝቦች", as the Amharic glossary sets for the Old Testament; "አሕዛብ" is kept for verses the New Testament quotes with it.

decisions.choice: मनभावनी वस्तुएँ (L), धन (B), धन-संपत्ति (R)
decisions.reason: The levels follow m1, the valuable things of the nations, with the verb in the plural as the Hebrew has it. Literal keeps the root sense "desirable"; Balanced and Readable say wealth, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "сокровища" (L), "богатства" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The levels follow m1, the valuables of the nations; the verb "will come" is plural with it in the Hebrew, so the line is not read of one person.

decisions.choice: chemdat kol-haggoyim "すべての国々の宝" (L), "富" (B), "国々の宝" (R), as the meaning decision; not "国々の望むもの" (the older personal reading, left to the footnote); goyim "国々", never "異邦人".
alternatives: "すべての国の民が慕い求めるもの"
decisions.reason: The plural verb points to things, not a person.

source.text: לִ֥י הַכֶּ֖סֶף וְלִ֣י הַזָּהָ֑ב נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Mine [is] the silver, and mine [is] the gold, declaration of Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: Mine [is] the silver, and {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}} [is] the gold, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: The silver belongs to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and the gold belongs to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: All the silver and gold belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: À {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} [est] l’argent, et à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} [est] l’or, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: L’argent est à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et l’or est à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Tout l’argent et tout l’or {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartiennent, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: Mía [es] la plata, y {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}} [es] el oro, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: La plata {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenece, y el oro {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenece, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: Toda la plata y el oro {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecen, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

sw.L: Fedha [ni] {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, na dhahabu [ni] {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.B: Fedha ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, na dhahabu ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.R: Fedha yote na dhahabu yote ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

vi.L: Bạc [là] của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và vàng [là] của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy.
vi.B: Bạc thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và vàng thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy.
vi.R: Tất cả bạc và vàng đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.

ko.L: 은도 내 것이고 금도 내 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 은도 내 것이고, 금도 내 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 은과 금은 모두 내 것이다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Minha [é] a prata, e {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} [é] o ouro, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.B: A prata pertence a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, e o ouro pertence a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.R: Toda a prata e todo o ouro pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.

am.L: ብሩ የእኔ ነው፤ ወርቁም የእኔ ነው፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት።
am.B: ብሩ የእኔ ነው፤ ወርቁም የእኔ ነው፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ብሩም ወርቁም ሁሉ የእኔ ነው፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: चाँदी मेरी [है], और सोना मेरा [है], सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: चाँदी मेरी है और सोना भी मेरा है, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: सारी चाँदी और सारा सोना मेरा है, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: Моё — серебро, и {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} — золото, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Саваофа.
ru.B: Серебро принадлежит {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}, и золото принадлежит {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф.
ru.R: Всё серебро и золото принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств.

ja.L: 銀はわたしのもの、金もわたしのものだ。――万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――
ja.B: 銀はわたしのもの、金もわたしのものである、と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: 銀も金も、すべてわたしのものだ、と天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

uk.L: Моє срібло, і {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} золото, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот.
uk.B: Срібло належить {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}, і золото належить {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ.
uk.R: Усе срібло й золото належить {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель.

decisions.choice: the silver and the gold are mine: all wealth belongs to the LORD
decisions.reason: The builders are poor, and the new house looks like nothing beside the old (verse 3). But all the world's wealth is the LORD's (Psalm 24:1; 50:10-12; 1 Chronicles 29:14-16), and he can bring it to his house when he chooses. |

decisions.choice: Mine ... mine (L, B), belong to me (R)
decisions.reason: The pronoun takes the deity_pronoun setting except where it begins the sentence. |

source.text: גָּד֣וֹל יִֽהְיֶ֡ה כְּבוֹד֩ הַבַּ֨יִת הַזֶּ֤ה הָאַֽחֲרוֹן֙ מִן־הָ֣רִאשׁ֔וֹן אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וּבַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן שָׁל֔וֹם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Great will be the glory of this house, the latter, more than the former, says Yahweh of hosts; and in this place I will give peace, declaration of Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: Greater will be the latter glory of this house than the first, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts; and in this place I will give peace, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: The glory of this house in the future will be greater than its glory in the past, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. And in this place I will give peace, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: This temple will be more glorious than it was before, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. And in this place I will give peace, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: Plus grande sera la dernière gloire de cette maison que la première, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées ; et dans ce lieu je donnerai la paix, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: La gloire future de cette maison sera plus grande que sa gloire passée, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Et dans ce lieu je donnerai la paix, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Ce temple sera plus glorieux qu’il ne l’a été autrefois, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Et dans ce lieu je donnerai la paix, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: Mayor será la gloria postrera de esta casa que la primera, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos; y en este lugar daré paz, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: La gloria futura de esta casa será mayor que la de antes, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Y en este lugar daré paz, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: Este templo será más glorioso que antes, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Y en este lugar daré paz, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

sw.L: Utukufu wa nyumba hii wa mwisho utakuwa mkuu kuliko ule wa kwanza, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi; na mahali hapa nitawapa amani, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.B: Utukufu wa nyumba hii wakati ujao utakuwa mkuu kuliko utukufu wake wa zamani, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Na mahali hapa nitaleta amani, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.R: Hekalu hili litakuwa na utukufu mkubwa kuliko lilivyokuwa zamani, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Na mahali hapa nitaleta amani, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

vi.L: Vinh quang sau này của nhà này sẽ lớn hơn vinh quang trước, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán; và tại nơi này {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban bình an, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy.
vi.B: Vinh quang của nhà này về sau sẽ lớn hơn vinh quang thuở trước, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. Và tại nơi này {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban bình an, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy.
vi.R: Đền thờ này sẽ vinh quang hơn trước kia, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. Và tại nơi này {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban bình an, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.

ko.L: 이 집의 나중 영광이 처음 것보다 클 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 이곳에 내가 평화를 주겠다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 앞으로 이 집이 누릴 영광은 예전의 영광보다 더 클 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그리고 이곳에 내가 평화를 주겠다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 이 성전은 예전보다 더 영광스러워질 것이다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그리고 이곳에 내가 평화를 주겠다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Maior será a glória posterior desta casa do que a primeira, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos; e neste lugar darei paz, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.B: A glória futura desta casa será maior do que a glória do passado, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. E neste lugar darei a paz, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.R: Este templo vai ter mais glória do que teve antes, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. E neste lugar eu vou dar paz, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.

am.R: ይህ ቤተ መቅደስ ከቀድሞው ይበልጥ የከበረ ይሆናል፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። በዚህም ስፍራ ሰላምን እሰጣለሁ፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

ru.L: Больше будет последняя слава этого дома, чем первая, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, — и на этом месте {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам мир, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Саваофа.
ru.B: Слава этого дома в будущем будет больше, чем его слава в прошлом, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф. И на этом месте {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам мир, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф.
ru.R: Этот храм будет славнее, чем был прежде, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств. И на этом месте {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам мир, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств.

ja.L: この家の後の栄光は、前のものより大きくなる、と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。そしてこの場所に、わたしは平和を与える。――万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――
ja.B: この家のこれからの栄光は、以前の栄光よりも大きくなる、と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。この場所に、わたしは平和を与える、と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: この神殿は、以前よりももっと栄光に満ちたものになる、と天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。この場所に、わたしは平和を与える、と天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

uk.L: Більшою буде остання слава цього дому, ніж перша, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот; і на цьому місці {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам мир, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот.
uk.B: Слава цього дому в майбутньому буде більшою, ніж його слава в минулому, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ. І на цьому місці {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам мир, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ.
uk.R: Цей храм буде славнішим, ніж був колись, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель. І на цьому місці {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам мир, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель.

decisions.choice: the latter glory of this house: the glory the house will have, greater than the glory it had
alternatives: the glory of this latter house will be greater than that of the former
decisions.reason: The word "latter" can go with "glory" or with "house". Haggai treats the temple as one house, which the old people saw "in its former glory" (verse 3), so the reading here is "the latter glory of this house". The other reading compares the new house with the first one. The promise is the same.

decisions.choice: peace: well-being, safety and wholeness
decisions.reason: The word means far more than the absence of war: it is wholeness, security and well-being (Isaiah 9:6; Jeremiah 29:7). It comes from the LORD, in the place where his house stands. |

decisions.choice: a promise beyond what Haggai's hearers saw
decisions.reason: The temple finished in 515 BC never matched Solomon's in splendor, and the ark was gone. The promises of verses 6-9 point beyond the building of Haggai's day to the time when the LORD would come to his house (Malachi 3:1). |

decisions.choice: peace at every level
decisions.reason: "Peace" follows the Isaiah table. "Glory" stays at every level; Readable says "more glorious". |

decisions.choice: "dice" and then "declara" / "afirma" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The verse has both 'amar and ne'um; L and B keep them apart, R says "dice" for both, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "bình an" for shalom
decisions.reason: The style guide's key term, the same at every level.

decisions.choice: *shalom* is "평화" at every level
decisions.reason: The English has "peace" at every level; "평화" is the term sheet's word in "평화의 언약" (Isaiah 54:10), and the promise here is for the land and city, not inner calm ("평안").

decisions.choice: "የዚህ ቤት የኋለኛው ክብር ከፊተኛው ታላቅ ይሆናል" (the latter glory of this house will be great, more than the former)
alternatives: "የዚህ የኋለኛው ቤት ክብር" (the glory of this latter house)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew can be read either way; the meaning decision takes "latter" with the glory, so Literal attaches it there and keeps the Hebrew's "great ... more than" with "ታላቅ ይሆናል".

decisions.choice: कहते हैं ('amar) beside की यह वाणी है (neum, L, B); शान्ति
decisions.reason: The verse has both the plain verb and the formula; Literal and Balanced keep them apart, कहते हैं and की यह वाणी है, as the English keeps "says" and "declares". Peace (shalom) is शान्ति, the key term.

decisions.choice: "— говорит ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф" then "— слово ГОСПОДА Саваофа" (L)
decisions.reason: The verse has amar YHWH and then neum YHWH; Literal keeps them apart as the prophets note's table does, and the other levels say "говорит" for both.

decisions.choice: shalom "平和" at every level (well-being and safety for the place), not "平安" (inner peace).
decisions.reason: Style guide key-term rule for peace.

ko.L: 다리오 제2년 아홉째 [달] 이십사일에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 예언자 학개에게 임하여 말씀하셨다.

pt.B: No vigésimo quarto dia do nono mês, no segundo ano de Dario, a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} veio ao profeta Ageu:

ru.L: В двадцать четвёртый [день] девятого [месяца], во второй год Дария, было слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} к Аггею пророку, говоря:

ja.L: 第九[の月]の二十四日、ダレイオスの第二年に、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉が預言者ハガイに臨んで言った。
ja.B: ダレイオスの第二年、第九の月の二十四日に、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉が預言者ハガイに臨んだ。
ja.R: ダレイオスが王になって二年目の、第九の月の二十四日に、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、預言者ハガイに次のように語られました。

uk.L: Двадцять четвертого [дня] девʼятого [місяця], у другому році Дарія, було слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} до Огія, пророка, кажучи:
uk.B: Двадцять четвертого дня девʼятого місяця, у другому році Дарія, було слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} до пророка Огія:
uk.R: Двадцять четвертого дня девʼятого місяця, у другий рік царювання Дарія, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав пророкові Огію:

decisions.choice: the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month: mid-December 520 BC
decisions.reason: The date is about 18 December 520 BC, three months after the work began (1:15). The ninth month (Kislev) came after the early rains, when the winter grain was sown. |

decisions.choice: came to Haggai: a message given to the prophet himself
decisions.reason: This time the word comes "to" Haggai, not "by the hand of" him to others: he is to put questions to the priests (verses 11-13) and then give the people the answer. |

decisions.choice: the Hebrew form of the date at every level
decisions.reason: The date keeps its Hebrew form, as in 1:1. Literal leaves out "day" and "month", as the Hebrew does (compare 1:15). Readable says "as king", which is understood. |

decisions.choice: "[день]", "[месяца]" (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew leaves out "day" and "month"; Russian needs them to read the ordinals, so Literal brackets them.

fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Demande aux prêtres de donner une instruction sur cette question :

vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Hãy xin các thầy tế lễ cho biết luật pháp dạy thế nào:

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 이제 제사장들에게 율법에 대한 가르침을 물어 말하여라.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 제사장들에게 이 문제에 대하여 율법의 가르침을 물어보아라.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 제사장들에게 율법에 따라 판단해 달라고 하여라.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Pede agora aos sacerdotes uma instrução, dizendo:
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Pede aos sacerdotes uma instrução sobre esta questão:
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos diz: Pede aos sacerdotes que deem uma decisão com base na Lei:

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት እንዲህ ይላል፦ እባክህ፣ ካህናቱን ትምህርት ጠይቃቸው፤ እንዲህም በል፦

am.R: የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ካህናቱ ከሕጉ ብይን እንዲሰጡ ጠይቃቸው፦

hi.L: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: याजकों से शिक्षा माँगो, और पूछो:
