hi.R: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: याजकों से कहो कि वे परमेश्वर की शिक्षा के अनुसार इसका निर्णय दें:

ru.L: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф: Спроси же священников о наставлении, говоря:
ru.B: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф: Спроси у священников наставления вот о чём:
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств: Попроси священников дать наставление вот о чём:

ja.L: 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。さあ、祭司たちに教えを尋ねて言いなさい。
ja.B: 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。次の問いについて、祭司たちに教えを求めなさい。
ja.R: 天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。祭司たちに、神の教えに基づいた答えを求めなさい。

uk.L: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот: Спитай, прошу, священників про настанову, кажучи:
uk.B: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ: Спитай священників про настанову щодо такого питання:
uk.R: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель: Попроси священників дати відповідь із Закону:

decisions.choice: instruction: a priest's ruling on a question of the law
decisions.reason: The word (torah) means teaching or instruction. The priests were to teach the people the difference between holy and common, clean and unclean (Leviticus 10:10-11), and to give rulings on hard cases (Deuteronomy 17:8-11; Malachi 2:7). Haggai asks them for such a ruling. |

decisions.choice: instruction (L, B), a ruling from the law (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "instruction", as the Isaiah table sets. Readable says "a ruling from the law", because here the word means a priest's answer to a particular question (m1). |

decisions.choice: "la ley" (L), "que te instruyan" (B), "una respuesta según la ley" (R)
decisions.reason: Torah here is a priest's ruling; Spanish L says "la ley", the sense a ruling has, and B and R say what was asked for.

decisions.choice: "sheria" (L); "mafundisho" (B); "uamuzi kutoka katika sheria" (R)
decisions.reason: Torah here is a priest's ruling on a point of the law; L keeps "sheria" and B "mafundisho", as the Psalms note sets for torah.

decisions.choice: "luật pháp" (L, R) / "chỉ dạy" (B) for torah, a priestly ruling
decisions.reason: Here torah is the priests' ruling from the law (the English "instruction" / "a ruling from the law"), so Vietnamese "luật pháp" is apt; in Habakkuk and Zephaniah 3:4, where it is God's teaching, it is "lời dạy dỗ".

decisions.choice: *torah* here is a priest's ruling: "율법에 대한 가르침" (L), "율법의 가르침" (B), "율법에 따라 판단" (R)
decisions.reason: Elsewhere in the prophets *torah* is "가르침"; here the priests are asked for a ruling under the law of Moses, so Korean names the law.

decisions.choice: uma instrução (L, B); uma decisão com base na Lei (R)
decisions.reason: Torah is "instrução" at Literal and Balanced, as Isaiah 2:3 has it in Portuguese; Readable says what a priest's torah is here (m1). The LORD speaks to Haggai with "tu", as to one person.

decisions.choice: instruction (torah) "ትምህርት" (L), "የሕግ ትምህርት" (B), "ከሕጉ ብይን" (a ruling from the law, R)
decisions.reason: Here torah is a priest's ruling on a question of the law (the meaning decision), not the Law as a book; "ትምህርት" (teaching) is the word's root sense, and Readable names the ruling as the English does.

decisions.choice: शिक्षा (L, B); परमेश्वर की शिक्षा के अनुसार निर्णय (R)
decisions.reason: Torah in the Prophets is शिक्षा at every level, as the prophets note settles; Readable says it is a ruling given by God's teaching, as the English says "a ruling from the law", because here the word is a priest's answer to a question (m1).

decisions.choice: "наставление" (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The prophets note's "наставление" for torah; here it is a priest's ruling on a point of the law (m1), and the settled form keeps "наставление" at every level, Readable included.

decisions.choice: torah "教え" at every level (a priest's ruling), not "律法"; R "神の教えに基づいた答え" for the English R "a ruling from the law".
decisions.reason: Prophetic conventions: torah in the prophets is "教え".

source.text: הֵ֣ן׀יִשָּׂא־אִ֨ישׁ בְּשַׂר־קֹ֜דֶשׁ בִּכְנַ֣ף בִּגְד֗וֹ וְנָגַ֣ע בִּ֠כְנָפוֹ אֶל־הַלֶּ֨חֶם וְאֶל־הַנָּזִ֜יד וְאֶל־הַיַּ֧יִן וְאֶל־שֶׁ֛מֶן וְאֶל־כָּל־מַאֲכָ֖ל הֲיִקְדָּ֑שׁ וַיַּעֲנ֧וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: If a man carries holy flesh in [the] fold of his garment, and touches with his fold the bread or the cooked food or the wine or oil or any food, will it become holy? And the priests answered and said, No.

en.L: "If someone carries holy meat in the fold of {{gender:their|his}} garment, and with the fold touches bread or stew or wine or oil or any food, will it become holy?" And the priests answered and said, "No."
en.B: "Suppose someone carries consecrated meat in the fold of {{gender:their|his}} garment, and the fold touches bread or stew, wine or oil, or any other food. Does that food become holy?" The priests answered, "No."
en.R: "Suppose someone is carrying meat from a sacrifice in a fold of their clothes, and the clothes touch some bread, stew, wine, olive oil, or any other food. Will that food become holy?" The priests answered, "No."

fr.L: « Si quelqu’un porte de la viande sainte dans le pan de son vêtement, et touche avec ce pan du pain ou un plat cuit ou du vin ou de l’huile ou n’importe quel aliment, cela deviendra-t-il saint ? » Et les prêtres répondirent et dirent : « Non. »
fr.B: « Supposons que quelqu’un porte de la viande consacrée dans le pan de son vêtement, et que ce pan touche du pain ou un ragoût, du vin ou de l’huile, ou n’importe quel autre aliment. Cet aliment devient-il saint ? » Les prêtres répondirent : « Non. »
fr.R: « Supposons que quelqu’un porte de la viande d’un sacrifice dans un pli de ses vêtements, et que ses vêtements touchent du pain, un ragoût, du vin, de l’huile d’olive ou n’importe quel autre aliment. Cet aliment deviendra-t-il saint ? » Les prêtres ont répondu : « Non. »

es.L: «Si alguien lleva carne consagrada en el pliegue de su ropa, y con el pliegue toca pan, o guiso, o vino, o aceite, o cualquier alimento, ¿quedará santificado?». Y respondieron los sacerdotes y dijeron: «No».
es.B: «Supongamos que alguien lleva carne consagrada en el pliegue de su ropa, y con el pliegue toca pan o guiso, vino o aceite, o cualquier otro alimento. ¿Queda santificado ese alimento?». Los sacerdotes respondieron: «No».
es.R: «Supongamos que alguien lleva carne de un sacrificio en un pliegue de su ropa, y la ropa toca pan, guiso, vino, aceite de oliva o cualquier otro alimento. ¿Se volverá santo ese alimento?». Los sacerdotes respondieron: «No».

sw.L: "Mtu akibeba nyama takatifu katika upindo wa vazi lake, na kwa upindo huo akagusa mkate au mchuzi au divai au mafuta au chakula chochote, je, kitakuwa kitakatifu?" Na makuhani wakajibu, wakasema, "Hapana."
sw.B: "Tuseme mtu amebeba nyama iliyowekwa wakfu katika upindo wa vazi lake, na upindo huo ukagusa mkate au mchuzi, divai au mafuta, au chakula kingine chochote. Je, chakula hicho kitakuwa kitakatifu?" Makuhani wakajibu, "Hapana."
sw.R: "Tuseme mtu amebeba nyama ya dhabihu katika upindo wa nguo zake, na nguo hizo zikagusa mkate, mchuzi, divai, mafuta ya zeituni, au chakula kingine chochote. Je, chakula hicho kitakuwa kitakatifu?" Makuhani wakajibu, "Hapana."

vi.L: "Nếu ai mang thịt thánh trong vạt áo mình, và vạt áo ấy chạm vào bánh, hoặc món hầm, hoặc rượu, hoặc dầu, hoặc bất cứ thức ăn nào, thì vật đó có trở nên thánh không?" Các thầy tế lễ đáp rằng: "Không."
vi.B: "Giả sử có người mang thịt đã biệt riêng ra thánh trong vạt áo mình, rồi vạt áo chạm vào bánh hay món hầm, rượu hay dầu, hoặc bất cứ thức ăn nào khác. Thức ăn đó có trở nên thánh không?" Các thầy tế lễ đáp: "Không."
vi.R: "Giả sử có người đang mang thịt của một sinh tế trong vạt áo, và áo chạm vào bánh, món hầm, rượu, dầu ô-liu hay bất cứ thức ăn nào khác. Thức ăn đó có trở nên thánh không?" Các thầy tế lễ đáp: "Không."

ko.L: "만일 어떤 사람이 거룩한 고기를 자기 옷자락에 싸서 들고 가다가, 그 옷자락이 빵이나 국이나 포도주나 기름이나 어떤 음식에 닿으면, 그것이 거룩해지겠소?" 제사장들이 대답하여 말했다. "아닙니다."
ko.B: "어떤 사람이 거룩하게 구별된 고기를 옷자락에 싸서 가다가, 그 옷자락이 빵이나 국이나 포도주나 기름이나 다른 음식에 닿았다고 합시다. 그러면 그 음식이 거룩해지겠소?" 제사장들이 대답했다. "아닙니다."
ko.R: "어떤 사람이 제물로 바친 고기를 옷자락에 싸서 들고 간다고 합시다. 그런데 그 옷이 빵이나 국이나 포도주나 올리브기름이나 다른 음식에 닿았소. 그러면 그 음식이 거룩해지겠소?" 제사장들이 대답했다. "아닙니다."

pt.L: "Se alguém leva carne santa na dobra da sua roupa, e com a dobra toca pão, ou guisado, ou vinho, ou azeite, ou qualquer comida, ela se tornará santa?" E os sacerdotes responderam e disseram: "Não."
pt.B: "Suponham que alguém leve carne consagrada na dobra da roupa, e a dobra toque em pão ou em guisado, em vinho ou em azeite, ou em qualquer outra comida. Essa comida se torna santa?" Os sacerdotes responderam: "Não."
pt.R: "Suponham que alguém esteja levando carne de um sacrifício numa dobra da roupa, e a roupa encoste em pão, guisado, vinho, azeite ou qualquer outra comida. Essa comida fica santa?" Os sacerdotes responderam: "Não."

am.L: «አንድ ሰው የተቀደሰ ሥጋ በልብሱ ጫፍ ቢሸከም፣ በጫፉም እንጀራን ወይም ወጥን ወይም የወይን ጠጅን ወይም ዘይትን ወይም ማንኛውንም ምግብ ቢነካ፣ ያ ይቀደሳልን?» ካህናቱም መለሱ፤ እንዲህም አሉ፦ «አይሆንም።»
am.B: «አንድ ሰው የተቀደሰ ሥጋ በልብሱ ጫፍ ቋጥሮ ቢይዝ፣ ያም የልብሱ ጫፍ እንጀራን ወይም ወጥን፣ የወይን ጠጅን ወይም ዘይትን ወይም ሌላ ማንኛውንም ምግብ ቢነካ፣ ያ ምግብ ይቀደሳልን?» ካህናቱም እንዲህ ብለው መለሱ፦ «አይሆንም።»
am.R: «አንድ ሰው ከመሥዋዕት የሆነ ሥጋ በልብሱ ጠቅልሎ ቢሸከም፣ ልብሱም እንጀራን፣ ወጥን፣ የወይን ጠጅን፣ የወይራ ዘይትን ወይም ሌላ ማንኛውንም ምግብ ቢነካ፣ ያ ምግብ ይቀደሳልን?» ካህናቱም እንዲህ ብለው መለሱ፦ «አይሆንም።»

hi.L: "यदि कोई अपने वस्त्र के आँचल में पवित्र मांस ले जाए, और उस आँचल से रोटी या पकी हुई चीज़ या दाखमधु या तेल या किसी भी भोजन को छुए, तो क्या वह पवित्र हो जाएगा?" और याजकों ने उत्तर देकर कहा, "नहीं।"
hi.B: "मान लो कोई अपने वस्त्र के आँचल में पवित्र किया हुआ मांस ले जा रहा है, और वह आँचल रोटी या पकी हुई चीज़, दाखमधु या तेल, या किसी और भोजन से छू जाता है। क्या वह भोजन पवित्र हो जाता है?" याजकों ने उत्तर दिया, "नहीं।"
hi.R: "मान लो कोई बलि का मांस अपने कपड़ों की तह में लिए जा रहा है, और उसके कपड़े किसी रोटी, पकी हुई चीज़, दाखमधु, तेल या किसी और भोजन से छू जाते हैं। क्या वह भोजन पवित्र हो जाएगा?" याजकों ने उत्तर दिया, "नहीं।"

ru.L: «Если кто-то несёт святое мясо в складке своей одежды и коснётся складкой хлеба, или похлёбки, или вина, или масла, или какой-либо пищи, станет ли это святым?» И отвечали священники и сказали: «Нет.»
ru.B: «Предположим, кто-то несёт освящённое мясо в складке своей одежды, и складка коснётся хлеба или похлёбки, вина или масла, или другой пищи. Станет ли эта пища святой?» Священники ответили: «Нет.»
ru.R: «Допустим, кто-то несёт мясо от жертвы в складке своей одежды, и одежда касается хлеба, похлёбки, вина, оливкового масла или другой еды. Станет ли эта еда святой?» Священники ответили: «Нет.»

ja.L: 「もし人が聖なる肉を自分の衣のすそに包んで運び、そのすそでパンや煮物、ぶどう酒や油、あるいはどんな食べ物にでも触れたなら、それは聖なるものとなるか？」すると祭司たちは答えて言った。「いいえ。」
ja.B: 「人が聖なる肉を衣のすそに包んで運んでいて、そのすそがパンや煮物、ぶどう酒や油、あるいはほかのどんな食べ物に触れたとする。その食べ物は聖なるものとなるか？」祭司たちは答えた。「いいえ、なりません。」
ja.R: 「だれかが、いけにえの肉を服のすそに包んで運んでいるとする。その服がパンや煮物、ぶどう酒、オリーブ油、そのほかの食べ物に触れたら、その食べ物は聖なるものになるか？」祭司たちは答えました。「いいえ、なりません。」

uk.L: «Якщо хтось несе святе мʼясо в полі свого одягу і полою торкнеться хліба, чи вареної страви, чи вина, чи олії, чи будь-якої їжі, чи стане воно святим?» І відповіли священники і сказали: «Ні.»
uk.B: «Припустімо, хтось несе освячене мʼясо в полі свого одягу, і пола торкнеться хліба чи вареної страви, вина чи олії, чи будь-якої іншої їжі. Чи стане та їжа святою?» Священники відповіли: «Ні.»
uk.R: «Припустімо, хтось несе мʼясо з жертви в полі свого одягу, і одяг торкнеться хліба, вареної страви, вина, оливкової олії чи будь-якої іншої їжі. Чи стане та їжа святою?» Священники відповіли: «Ні.»

decisions.choice: holy meat in the fold of a garment: meat from a sacrifice, carried in a fold of the robe
decisions.reason: Meat from many sacrifices was holy and was to be eaten in a holy place (Leviticus 6:19-20 in the Hebrew numbering, 6:26-27 in many other Bibles; Jeremiah 11:15). A fold of a long robe served as a pocket. The law says that whatever touches the holy flesh becomes holy (Leviticus 6:20); the question is whether holiness passes on further, from the garment to a third thing. |

decisions.choice: the priests answered, No: holiness does not pass on at second hand
decisions.reason: The priests rule that the food is not made holy, because only the garment touched the meat. Verse 13 asks the matching question about uncleanness. |

decisions.choice: someone ... their garment (gender default)
decisions.reason: The word for "man" here means anyone, so the gender setting is used; Readable says "their clothes", which is already inclusive. The questions and answers are in double quotes, as prose quotes speech. |

decisions.choice: "quelqu'un … son vêtement", no gender span where the English has {{gender:their|his}}
decisions.reason: French "quelqu'un" is already inclusive and "son" agrees with the garment, so no setting is needed (style guide section 7).

decisions.choice: "alguien ... su ropa", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "alguien" and "su" already include women, so the English gender span has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: "mtu ... vazi lake" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Mtu" and "lake" cover men and women, so the English gender span has no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: "ai" / "có người" with "mình", no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "ai" and "mình" cover both men and women; the English gender span has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: Haggai asks the priests in 하오체 ("거룩해지겠소?"), and they answer in 합쇼체 ("아닙니다"); no gender span for "someone"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's address forms for Haggai and the priests (uncertain): a prophet speaking in his own voice to respected men of the community. Korean "어떤 사람" and "자기" cover both sexes, so the English gender span has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: alguém ... a sua roupa (L), a roupa (B), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: "Alguém" already means anyone, and "sua" agrees with "roupa", so Portuguese has no second wording for the English gender span.

decisions.choice: "someone ... his garment" as "አንድ ሰው ... በልብሱ", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "their / his" as a setting; Amharic "ሰው" with the generic masculine suffix already means anyone, so the Amharic has no span.

decisions.choice: holy meat "የተቀደሰ ሥጋ" (L, B, as Jeremiah 11:15), "ከመሥዋዕት የሆነ ሥጋ" (R); the fold of the garment "የልብሱ ጫፍ"; bread "እንጀራ"; stew "ወጥ"
decisions.reason: The meat was carried in the edge of the robe folded over (the meaning decision); "የልብሱ ጫፍ", the end of a garment used to tie up and carry things, says that, and Balanced adds "ቋጥሮ" (tied up). Bread as food is "እንጀራ", and cooked food is the everyday "ወጥ".

decisions.choice: कोई ... अपने वस्त्र, without a gender span
decisions.reason: The English puts the pronoun under the gender setting because the man here means anyone. Hindi कोई and अपने do not mark a man or a woman, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: "кто-то ... своей одежды" without a gender span
alternatives: a gender span, as in the English
decisions.reason: Russian "кто-то" with the reflexive "своей" already means anyone, man or woman, so no span is needed, as the style guide says.

decisions.choice: "人" / "自分の衣" with no gender span, where the English has someone ... their/his.
decisions.reason: The Japanese is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: The priests answer the prophet politely ("なりません", 2:13 "汚れます"); the narration of 2:12-14 is plain (L, B), です・ます (R).
decisions.reason: Speakers keep their own register; the frame follows the narrative rule.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר חַגַּ֔י אִם־יִגַּ֧ע טְמֵא־נֶ֛פֶשׁ בְּכָל־אֵ֖לֶּה הֲיִטְמָ֑א וַיַּעֲנ֧וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ יִטְמָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And Haggai said, If one unclean by a dead body touches any of these, will it become unclean? And the priests answered and said, It will become unclean.

en.L: And Haggai said, "If one who is unclean from a dead body touches any of these, will it become unclean?" And the priests answered and said, "It will become unclean."
en.B: Then Haggai asked, "If someone who is unclean from contact with a dead body touches any of these, does it become unclean?" The priests answered, "Yes, it becomes unclean."
en.R: Then Haggai asked, "Suppose someone has become unclean by touching a dead body. If that person touches any of these foods, will the food become unclean?" The priests answered, "Yes, it will."

fr.L: Et Aggée dit : « Si quelqu’un d’impur à cause d’un mort touche l’une de ces choses, deviendra-t-elle impure ? » Et les prêtres répondirent et dirent : « Elle deviendra impure. »
fr.B: Alors Aggée demanda : « Si quelqu’un qui est impur pour avoir touché un mort touche l’une de ces choses, devient-elle impure ? » Les prêtres répondirent : « Oui, elle devient impure. »
fr.R: Alors Aggée a demandé : « Supposons que quelqu’un est devenu impur en touchant un mort. S’il touche l’un de ces aliments, l’aliment deviendra-t-il impur ? » Les prêtres ont répondu : « Oui. »

es.L: Y dijo Hageo: «Si alguien impuro por [contacto con] un cadáver toca cualquiera de estas cosas, ¿quedará impura?». Y respondieron los sacerdotes y dijeron: «Quedará impura».
es.B: Entonces Hageo preguntó: «Si alguien que está impuro por haber tocado un cadáver toca cualquiera de estas cosas, ¿queda impura?». Los sacerdotes respondieron: «Sí, queda impura».
es.R: Entonces Hageo preguntó: «Supongamos que alguien ha quedado impuro por tocar un cadáver. Si esa persona toca cualquiera de esos alimentos, ¿quedará impuro el alimento?». Los sacerdotes respondieron: «Sí, quedará impuro».

sw.L: Na Hagai akasema, "Mtu aliye najisi kwa sababu ya maiti akigusa chochote kati ya hivi, je, kitakuwa najisi?" Na makuhani wakajibu, wakasema, "Kitakuwa najisi."
sw.B: Kisha Hagai akauliza, "Mtu aliye najisi kwa kugusa maiti akigusa chochote kati ya hivi, je, kinakuwa najisi?" Makuhani wakajibu, "Ndiyo, kinakuwa najisi."
sw.R: Kisha Hagai akauliza, "Tuseme mtu amekuwa najisi kwa kugusa maiti. Mtu huyo akigusa chochote kati ya vyakula hivi, je, chakula hicho kitakuwa najisi?" Makuhani wakajibu, "Ndiyo, kitakuwa najisi."

vi.L: A-ghê nói: "Nếu một người bị ô uế vì xác chết chạm vào bất cứ vật nào trong những vật này, thì vật đó có trở nên ô uế không?" Các thầy tế lễ đáp rằng: "Nó sẽ trở nên ô uế."
vi.B: Bấy giờ A-ghê hỏi: "Nếu một người bị ô uế vì đụng vào xác chết rồi chạm vào bất cứ vật nào trong những thứ này, vật đó có bị ô uế không?" Các thầy tế lễ đáp: "Có, nó bị ô uế."
vi.R: Bấy giờ A-ghê hỏi: "Giả sử có người đã bị ô uế vì đụng vào xác chết. Nếu người ấy chạm vào bất cứ thức ăn nào trong những thứ này, thức ăn đó có bị ô uế không?" Các thầy tế lễ đáp: "Có."

ko.L: 그리고 학개가 말했다. "시체 때문에 부정하게 된 사람이 이것들 가운데 어느 것에 닿으면, 그것이 부정해지겠소?" 제사장들이 대답하여 말했다. "부정해집니다."
ko.B: 학개가 또 물었다. "시체에 닿아 부정하게 된 사람이 이것들 가운데 어느 하나에 닿으면, 그것이 부정해지겠소?" 제사장들이 대답했다. "예, 부정해집니다."
ko.R: 학개가 또 물었다. "어떤 사람이 시체를 만져서 부정하게 되었다고 합시다. 그 사람이 이 음식들 가운데 하나를 만지면, 그 음식이 부정해지겠소?" 제사장들이 대답했다. "예, 그렇습니다."

pt.L: E Ageu disse: "Se alguém impuro por [causa de] um cadáver tocar em qualquer destas coisas, ela se tornará impura?" E os sacerdotes responderam e disseram: "Ficará impura."
pt.B: Então Ageu perguntou: "Se alguém que está impuro por ter tocado num cadáver tocar em qualquer destas coisas, ela se torna impura?" Os sacerdotes responderam: "Sim, ela se torna impura."
pt.R: Então Ageu perguntou: "Suponham que alguém ficou impuro por tocar num cadáver. Se essa pessoa tocar em qualquer dessas comidas, a comida vai ficar impura?" Os sacerdotes responderam: "Sim, vai."

am.L: ሐጌም እንዲህ አለ፦ «በሬሳ ምክንያት የረከሰ [ሰው] ከእነዚህ ማናቸውንም ቢነካ፣ ያ ይረክሳልን?» ካህናቱም መለሱ፤ እንዲህም አሉ፦ «ይረክሳል።»
am.B: ከዚያም ሐጌ እንዲህ ብሎ ጠየቀ፦ «ሬሳ በመንካት የረከሰ ሰው ከእነዚህ አንዱን ቢነካ፣ ያ ይረክሳልን?» ካህናቱም እንዲህ ብለው መለሱ፦ «አዎ፣ ይረክሳል።»
am.R: ከዚያም ሐጌ እንዲህ ብሎ ጠየቀ፦ «አንድ ሰው ሬሳ ነክቶ ረክሷል እንበል። ያ ሰው ከእነዚህ ምግቦች አንዱን ቢነካ፣ ምግቡ ይረክሳልን?» ካህናቱም እንዲህ ብለው መለሱ፦ «አዎ፣ ይረክሳል።»

hi.L: तब हाग्गै ने कहा, "यदि कोई जो लाश के कारण अशुद्ध है, इनमें से किसी को छुए, तो क्या वह अशुद्ध हो जाएगा?" और याजकों ने उत्तर देकर कहा, "वह अशुद्ध हो जाएगा।"
hi.B: फिर हाग्गै ने पूछा, "यदि कोई जो लाश छूने से अशुद्ध हुआ हो, इनमें से किसी को छुए, तो क्या वह अशुद्ध हो जाता है?" याजकों ने उत्तर दिया, "हाँ, वह अशुद्ध हो जाता है।"
hi.R: फिर हाग्गै ने पूछा, "मान लो कोई लाश छूकर अशुद्ध हो गया है। अगर वह इनमें से किसी भोजन को छुए, तो क्या वह भोजन अशुद्ध हो जाएगा?" याजकों ने उत्तर दिया, "हाँ, हो जाएगा।"

ru.L: И сказал Аггей: «Если нечистый от мёртвого тела коснётся чего-нибудь из этого, станет ли это нечистым?» И отвечали священники и сказали: «Станет нечистым.»
ru.B: Тогда Аггей спросил: «Если тот, кто нечист от прикосновения к мёртвому телу, коснётся чего-нибудь из этого, станет ли это нечистым?» Священники ответили: «Да, станет нечистым.»
ru.R: Тогда Аггей спросил: «Допустим, кто-то стал нечистым, потому что коснулся мёртвого тела. Если этот человек коснётся какой-нибудь из этих пищ, станет ли пища нечистой?» Священники ответили: «Да, станет.»

ja.L: そしてハガイは言った。「もし死体によって汚れた者が、これらのどれかに触れたなら、それは汚れるか？」祭司たちは答えて言った。「汚れます。」
ja.B: そこでハガイは尋ねた。「死体に触れて汚れた人が、これらのどれかに触れたなら、それは汚れるか？」祭司たちは答えた。「はい、汚れます。」
ja.R: そこでハガイは尋ねました。「だれかが死体に触れて汚れたとする。その人が、これらの食べ物のどれかに触れたら、その食べ物は汚れるか？」祭司たちは答えました。「はい、汚れます。」

uk.L: І сказав Огій: «Якщо нечистий через мертве тіло торкнеться будь-чого з цього, чи стане воно нечистим?» І відповіли священники і сказали: «Стане нечистим.»
uk.B: Тоді Огій спитав: «Якщо хтось, нечистий через дотик до мертвого тіла, торкнеться будь-чого з цього, чи стане воно нечистим?» Священники відповіли: «Так, стане нечистим.»
uk.R: Тоді Огій спитав: «Припустімо, хтось став нечистим, торкнувшись мертвого тіла. Якщо ця людина торкнеться будь-якої з цих страв, чи стане їжа нечистою?» Священники відповіли: «Так, стане.»

decisions.choice: unclean from a dead body: the strongest kind of uncleanness
decisions.reason: Touching a dead body made a person unclean for seven days, and whatever that person touched became unclean too (Numbers 19:11-22). |

decisions.choice: uncleanness spreads where holiness does not
decisions.reason: Together, the two answers make Haggai's point: holiness does not pass on easily, but uncleanness does. Being near the holy place does not make a person holy, but an unclean person defiles what he touches. |

decisions.choice: Yes, it becomes unclean (B); Yes, it will (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew answers by repeating the verb, which is how Hebrew says "yes". |

decisions.choice: unclean from a dead body "በሬሳ ምክንያት የረከሰ" (L), "ሬሳ በመንካት የረከሰ" (B), "ሬሳ ነክቶ ረክሷል" (R), as Numbers 9:6; become unclean "ረከሰ"
decisions.reason: The law's wording for corpse uncleanness on main (Numbers 9:6) is kept, so the priests' answer rests on the rule the reader has met there.

source.text: וַיַּ֨עַן חַגַּ֜י וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כֵּ֣ן הָֽעָם־הַ֠זֶּה וְכֵן־הַגּ֨וֹי הַזֶּ֤ה לְפָנַי֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה וְכֵ֖ן כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יַקְרִ֛יבוּ שָׁ֖ם טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And Haggai answered and said, So [is] this people and so [is] this nation before me, declaration of Yahweh, and so [is] all [the] work of their hands; and what they offer there [is] unclean.

en.L: And Haggai answered and said, "Such is this people, and such is this nation before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and such is all the work of their hands; and what they offer there is unclean."
en.B: Then Haggai said, "So it is with this people and this nation in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and so it is with everything they do; whatever they offer there is unclean."
en.R: Then Haggai said, "This is what these people are like in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Everything they do is unclean, and so is every offering they bring to the altar."

fr.L: Et Aggée répondit et dit : « Tel est ce peuple, et telle est cette nation devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et tel est tout le travail de leurs mains ; et ce qu’ils offrent là est impur. »
fr.B: Alors Aggée dit : « Il en est ainsi de ce peuple et de cette nation à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et il en est ainsi de tout ce qu’ils font ; tout ce qu’ils offrent là est impur. »
fr.R: Alors Aggée a dit : « Voilà comment sont ces gens à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Tout ce qu’ils font est impur, et toutes les offrandes qu’ils apportent à l’autel aussi. »

es.L: Y respondió Hageo y dijo: «Así es este pueblo, y así es esta nación delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y así es toda la obra de sus manos; y lo que ofrecen allí es impuro».
es.B: Entonces Hageo dijo: «Así sucede con este pueblo y con esta nación delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y así sucede con todo lo que hacen; todo lo que ofrecen allí es impuro».
es.R: Entonces Hageo dijo: «Así es esta gente a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Todo lo que hacen es impuro, y también lo son todas las ofrendas que traen al altar».

sw.L: Na Hagai akajibu, akasema, "Ndivyo walivyo watu hawa, na ndivyo lilivyo taifa hili mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na ndivyo ilivyo kazi yote ya mikono yao; na wanachotoa huko ni najisi."
sw.B: Kisha Hagai akasema, "Ndivyo ilivyo kwa watu hawa na kwa taifa hili machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na ndivyo ilivyo kwa kila kitu wanachofanya; chochote wanachotoa huko ni najisi."
sw.R: Kisha Hagai akasema, "Hivi ndivyo walivyo watu hawa machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kila kitu wanachofanya ni najisi, na vivyo hivyo kila sadaka wanayoileta madhabahuni."

vi.L: A-ghê đáp rằng: "Dân này cũng vậy, và nước này cũng vậy trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và mọi công việc của tay chúng cũng vậy; và những gì chúng dâng tại đó đều ô uế."
vi.B: Bấy giờ A-ghê nói: "Dân này và nước này trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng như vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Mọi việc tay chúng làm cũng thế; bất cứ gì chúng dâng tại đó đều ô uế."
vi.R: Bấy giờ A-ghê nói: "Trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, dân này cũng giống như vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Mọi việc chúng làm đều ô uế, và mọi lễ vật chúng đem đến bàn thờ cũng ô uế."

ko.L: 그러자 학개가 대답하여 말했다. "이 백성이 그러하고, 내 앞에서 이 민족이 그러하다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그들의 손으로 하는 모든 일이 그러하다. 그들이 거기서 바치는 것도 부정하다."
ko.B: 그러자 학개가 말했다. "내가 보기에 이 백성과 이 민족이 바로 그렇다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그들이 하는 모든 일이 그렇다. 그들이 거기서 바치는 것은 무엇이든 부정하다."
ko.R: 그러자 학개가 말했다. "내가 보기에 이 백성이 바로 그렇다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그들이 하는 모든 일이 부정하고, 그들이 제단에 가져오는 제물도 모두 부정하다."

pt.L: E Ageu respondeu e disse: "Assim [é] este povo, e assim [é] esta nação diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e assim [é] toda a obra das mãos deles; e o que eles oferecem ali é impuro."
pt.B: Então Ageu disse: "Assim é com este povo e com esta nação diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e assim é com tudo o que fazem: tudo o que oferecem ali é impuro."
pt.R: Então Ageu disse: "É assim que este povo é aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Tudo o que fazem é impuro, e também é impura toda oferta que trazem ao altar."

am.L: ሐጌም መለሰ፤ እንዲህም አለ፦ «ይህ ሕዝብ እንዲሁ ነው፤ ይህም ወገን በፊቴ እንዲሁ ነው፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ የእጃቸውም ሥራ ሁሉ እንዲሁ ነው፤ በዚያም የሚያቀርቡት ርኩስ ነው።»
am.B: ከዚያም ሐጌ እንዲህ አለ፦ «ይህ ሕዝብና ይህ ወገን በፊቴ እንዲሁ ነው፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ የሚያደርጉትም ሁሉ እንዲሁ ነው፤ በዚያ የሚያቀርቡት ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።»
am.R: ከዚያም ሐጌ እንዲህ አለ፦ «እነዚህ ሰዎች በፊቴ እንደዚህ ናቸው፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። የሚያደርጉት ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው፤ በመሠዊያው ላይ የሚያቀርቡት መሥዋዕት ሁሉ ደግሞ ርኩስ ነው።»

hi.L: तब हाग्गै ने उत्तर देकर कहा, "ऐसी ही यह प्रजा है, और ऐसी ही यह जाति मेरे सामने है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, और ऐसा ही उनके हाथों का सारा काम है; और जो कुछ वे वहाँ चढ़ाते हैं, वह अशुद्ध है।"
hi.B: तब हाग्गै ने कहा, "मेरी दृष्टि में यह प्रजा और यह राष्ट्र ऐसा ही है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, और उनका सारा काम भी ऐसा ही है; जो कुछ वे वहाँ चढ़ाते हैं, वह अशुद्ध है।"
hi.R: तब हाग्गै ने कहा, "मेरी दृष्टि में ये लोग ऐसे ही हैं, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। वे जो कुछ करते हैं, वह अशुद्ध है, और हर भेंट जो वे वेदी पर चढ़ाते हैं, वह भी अशुद्ध है।"

ru.L: И отвечал Аггей и сказал: «Таков этот народ, и таково это племя передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}}, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — и таково всё дело их рук; и то, что они приносят там, нечисто.»
ru.B: Тогда Аггей сказал: «Так обстоит дело с этим народом и с этим племенем в {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} глазах, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — и так со всем, что они делают: всё, что они приносят там, нечисто.»
ru.R: Тогда Аггей сказал: «Таковы эти люди в {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} глазах, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Всё, что они делают, нечисто, и нечисто всякое приношение, которое они приносят к жертвеннику.»

ja.L: ハガイは答えて言った。「この民はそのようであり、この国もわたしの前にそのようである。――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――彼らの手のすべての業もそのようであり、彼らがそこでささげる物も汚れている。」
ja.B: そこでハガイは言った。「この民も、この国も、わたしの目にはそれと同じだ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。彼らの行うことはすべて同じであり、彼らがそこでささげる物はみな汚れている。」
ja.R: そこでハガイは言いました。「わたしの目には、この民はそのようなものだ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。彼らのすることはすべて汚れていて、彼らが祭壇にささげる物も、みな汚れている。」

uk.L: І відповів Огій і сказав: «Такий цей народ, і такий цей люд переді {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}}, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і таке все діло їхніх рук; і що вони приносять там, нечисте.»
uk.B: Тоді Огій сказав: «Так і з цим народом, і з цим людом в {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} очах, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і так з усім, що вони роблять; усе, що вони приносять там, нечисте.»
uk.R: Тоді Огій сказав: «Такі ці люди в {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} очах, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Усе, що вони роблять, нечисте, і кожна жертва, яку вони приносять на жертовник, теж нечиста.»

decisions.choice: so is this people: unclean, and their offerings with them
decisions.reason: Haggai applies the rulings to the people. The text does not say what made them unclean. In the setting of the book it is most likely their neglect of the LORD's house (1:4, 9), during which their offerings on the altar could not make them holy, while their own state made their offerings unclean. Some think of contact with the mixed peoples of the land, but the book does not mention it.

decisions.choice: what they offer there: the sacrifices on the altar
decisions.reason: The altar had been rebuilt when the exiles first returned, and sacrifices were offered there even while the temple lay in ruins (Ezra 3:2-6). |

decisions.choice: the Greek translation adds lines at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: The Greek translation is generally said to add several lines here, about gain gained unjustly and about hating the one who reproves in the gate, words that recall Amos 5:10. They are not in the Hebrew text and are not translated.

decisions.choice: this people ... this nation
decisions.reason: The LORD says "this people" and "this nation", not "my people", as in 1:2. Readable says "bring to the altar" for "offer there" (m2). |

decisions.choice: "dân này", "nước này", with "chúng" for the people
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: God speaks of them with distance, as in 1:2; the oracle's "chúng" for those under rebuke follows the terms note.

decisions.choice: Haggai's answer passes on the LORD's word, so it is 해라체 with God's "나", not Haggai's 하오체
decisions.reason: As the term sheet says for Ezekiel: the prophet speaks in his own voice in 하오체, but the oracle he passes on stays 해라체 (uncertain).

decisions.choice: this people "ይህ ሕዝብ" (am), this nation "ይህ ወገን" (goy)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets two words side by side, as the English "people ... nation" does; "ወገን" keeps the second one distinct without the political sense of "ብሔር". Readable joins them, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: यह प्रजा, यह जाति (L); यह प्रजा, यह राष्ट्र (B); ये लोग (R)
decisions.reason: The LORD says "this people" and "this nation", not "my people", as in 1:2. "Nation" follows the poetry note's rule, जाति at Literal and राष्ट्र at Balanced.

decisions.choice: "этот народ ... это племя" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The LORD says "this people", not "my people", as in 1:2; the second word (goy) is kept apart as "племя".

decisions.choice: ha'am hazzeh / haggoy hazzeh "この民" / "この国" (L, B), R one phrase "この民" as the English R.
decisions.reason: Keeps the distant "this people" of 1:2.

source.text: וְעַתָּה֙ שִֽׂימוּ־נָ֣א לְבַבְכֶ֔ם מִן־הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה מִטֶּ֧רֶם שֽׂוּם־אֶ֛בֶן אֶל־אֶ֖בֶן בְּהֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, set, please, your heart from this day and upward: before [the] placing of a stone on a stone in [the] temple of Yahweh,

en.L: And now, set your heart, please, from this day and upward: before stone was laid on stone in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}},
en.B: So now, think carefully about how things have been up to this day, before one stone was laid on another in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple:
en.R: Now think carefully about what life was like before you started to rebuild {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple.

fr.L: Et maintenant, mettez donc votre cœur [à considérer], depuis ce jour et en remontant : avant qu’on ait posé pierre sur pierre dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}},
fr.B: Maintenant donc, réfléchissez bien à ce qui s’est passé jusqu’à ce jour, avant qu’on ait posé une pierre sur une autre dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} :
fr.R: Maintenant, réfléchissez bien à ce qu’était la vie avant que vous commenciez à reconstruire le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

es.L: Y ahora, {{plural_you:pongan|poned}}, por favor, {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}} desde este día en adelante: antes de que se pusiera piedra sobre piedra en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}},
es.B: Así que ahora, {{plural_you:piensen|pensad}} bien en cómo han ido las cosas hasta hoy, antes de que se pusiera una piedra sobre otra en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}:
es.R: Ahora {{plural_you:piensen|pensad}} bien en cómo era la vida antes de que {{plural_you:comenzaran|comenzarais}} a reconstruir el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na sasa, tafadhali wekeni mioyo yenu tangu siku hii na kurudi nyuma: kabla jiwe halijawekwa juu ya jiwe katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}},
sw.B: Basi sasa, fikirini kwa makini jinsi mambo yalivyokuwa mpaka siku hii, kabla jiwe moja halijawekwa juu ya jingine katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}:
sw.R: Sasa fikirini kwa makini jinsi maisha yalivyokuwa kabla hamjaanza kulijenga upya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Và bây giờ, xin các ngươi hãy để lòng từ ngày này trở về trước: trước khi đá được chồng lên đá trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}},
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, hãy suy xét kỹ mọi việc cho đến ngày nay, trước khi người ta đặt hòn đá này lên hòn đá kia trong đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}:
vi.R: Bây giờ hãy suy nghĩ kỹ xem đời sống các ngươi ra sao trước khi các ngươi bắt đầu xây lại đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그러니 이제 이날부터 이전을 너희 마음에 두어라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 돌 위에 돌을 놓기 전에,
ko.B: 그러니 이제 오늘 이전에는 어떠했는지 깊이 생각해 보아라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 돌 하나 위에 다른 돌을 놓기 전에는 어떠했느냐?
ko.R: 이제 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 다시 짓기 시작하기 전에는 어떻게 살았는지 잘 생각해 보아라.

pt.L: E agora, ponham o coração, por favor, deste dia para trás: antes de se pôr pedra sobre pedra no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}},
pt.B: Agora, pois, considerem como as coisas têm sido até este dia, antes que se pusesse uma pedra sobre outra no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}:
pt.R: Agora pensem bem em como era a vida antes de vocês começarem a reconstruir o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

am.L: አሁንም እባካችሁ፣ ከዚህ ቀን ጀምሮ ወደ ኋላ ልባችሁን [በዚህ ላይ] አድርጉ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} መቅደስ ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ ሳይቀመጥ፣
am.B: እንግዲህ አሁን እስከዚህ ቀን ድረስ፣ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ ከመቀመጡ በፊት ነገሮች እንዴት እንደ ነበሩ በጥንቃቄ አስቡ፦
am.R: አሁንም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቤተ መቅደስ እንደ ገና መሥራት ከመጀመራችሁ በፊት ኑሮአችሁ ምን ይመስል እንደ ነበረ በጥንቃቄ አስቡ።

hi.L: और अब, आज के दिन से पीछे की ओर अपना मन लगाओ: उससे पहले कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मन्दिर में पत्थर पर पत्थर रखा गया,
hi.B: इसलिए अब ध्यान से सोचो कि आज के दिन तक कैसा रहा, उससे पहले कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मन्दिर में एक पत्थर पर दूसरा पत्थर रखा गया:
hi.R: अब ध्यान से सोचो कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का मन्दिर फिर से बनाना शुरू करने से पहले जीवन कैसा था।

ru.L: И теперь обратите же ваше сердце с этого дня и назад: прежде чем был положен камень на камень в храме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}},
ru.B: А теперь задумайтесь о том, как было до этого дня, прежде чем в храме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} положили камень на камень:
ru.R: А теперь подумайте хорошенько о том, как вы жили, пока не начали заново строить храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

ja.L: そして今、どうか、この日から以前へと、あなたがたの心を置け。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿で石が石の上に置かれる前、
ja.B: そこで今、この日に至るまでのことを、よく考えなさい。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿で、石の上に石が積まれる前のことを。
ja.R: 今、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿を建て直し始める前、暮らしがどうだったかを、よく考えなさい。

uk.L: А тепер покладіть, прошу, ваше серце від цього дня й назад: перш ніж покладено камінь на камінь у храмі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}},
uk.B: Тож тепер подумайте добре, як було аж до цього дня, перш ніж покладено камінь на камінь у храмі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}:
uk.R: Тепер подумайте добре, яким було життя, перш ніж ви почали відбудовувати храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: from this day and upward: back from this day
decisions.reason: The phrase can look forward ("from this day on") or back. Here what follows looks back to the time before the building began (verses 15-17), and verse 18 repeats the phrase looking forward to the blessing (verse 19). Some read it as forward in both places.

decisions.choice: before stone was laid on stone: before the work on the temple began
decisions.reason: Laying one stone on another is the start of building. The time before is the time of neglect described in 1:6-11. |

decisions.choice: think carefully (B, R), set your heart (L)
decisions.reason: "Set your heart" follows 1:5 at each level. Balanced and Readable make plain that the look is backward (m1). Readable says "before you started to rebuild" for "before stone was laid on stone".

decisions.choice: "pongan su corazón" (L); "piensen bien" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The idiom of 1:5 and 1:7 is kept at L and explained at B and R with the same words as there.

decisions.choice: "tangu siku hii na kurudi nyuma" (L)
decisions.reason: The meaning decisions read verses 15-17 as looking back over the time before the rebuilding, so the Literal says "kurudi nyuma" (back from this day); the English "upward" is ambiguous, and verse 18 looks forward.

decisions.choice: "từ ngày này trở về trước" at Literal
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "from this day and upward" as looking back on the time before the rebuilding; Vietnamese says "trở về trước" so the direction is clear.

decisions.choice: "set your heart" is "너희 마음에 두어라" (L) and "깊이 생각해 보아라", "잘 생각해 보아라" (B, R), as in 1:5, 7 and 2:18
decisions.reason: The refrain of Haggai keeps one wording at each level.

decisions.choice: deste dia para trás (L); deste dia em diante (2:18, L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "from this day and upward" looks back here and forward in verse 18 (m1, and m2 there). "Para cima" says neither in Portuguese, so Literal gives each place its direction, as the English Balanced and Readable do. The call keeps the wording of 1:5 at each level.

decisions.choice: "from this day and upward" as "ከዚህ ቀን ጀምሮ ወደ ኋላ" (back from this day, L), "እስከዚህ ቀን ድረስ" (up to this day, B); set your heart as in 1:5 ("ልባችሁን [በዚህ ላይ] አድርጉ" L, "በጥንቃቄ አስቡ" B, R); the temple (heikhal) "መቅደስ" (L), "ቤተ መቅደስ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the phrase here as looking back from this day, and a literal "upward" says nothing in Amharic, so Literal gives the direction it means; 2:18 uses the same phrase looking forward. Heikhal is "መቅደስ" at Literal, as in Kings.

decisions.choice: पीछे की ओर (L); आज के दिन तक (B); मन्दिर for hekhal
decisions.reason: "From this day and upward" here looks back (m1), so Literal says पीछे की ओर, and Balanced and Readable make the backward look plain, as the English does. The word here is hekhal, the temple, so every level says मन्दिर, as the history note sets.

decisions.choice: "с этого дня и назад" (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "and upward" here looks back from this day (m1); Literal says "назад" so the direction is not lost. In verse 18 the same words look forward ("и далее").

decisions.choice: sim levav as 1:5: "あなたがたの心を置け" (L), "よく考えなさい" (B, R); mimma'lah "この日から以前へと" (L), "この日に至るまで" (B), backward-looking as the English (uncertain, footnoted in the meaning decision).
decisions.reason: Keeps the 1:5 refrain verb; the direction follows the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: L ends with "、" and runs on into 2:16, as the English L.
decisions.reason: Keeps the sentence across the verse boundary at L only.

source.text: מִֽהְיוֹתָ֥ם בָּא֙ אֶל־עֲרֵמַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְהָיְתָ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֑ה בָּ֣א אֶל־הַיֶּ֗קֶב לַחְשֹׂף֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים פּוּרָ֔ה וְהָיְתָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: since they were, one came to a heap of twenty, and it was ten; one came to the wine vat to draw fifty [from the] press, and it was twenty.

en.L: since those days, one came to a heap of twenty [measures], and there were ten; one came to the wine vat to draw fifty [measures from] the press, and there were twenty.
en.B: how, when someone came to a heap of grain expecting twenty measures, there were only ten, and when someone came to the wine vat to draw fifty measures, there were only twenty.
en.R: In those days, when someone went to a pile of grain expecting twenty measures, there were only ten. When someone went to the wine vat expecting to draw fifty measures of wine, there were only twenty.

fr.L: depuis ces jours-là, on venait à un tas de vingt [mesures], et il y en avait dix ; on venait à la cuve pour puiser cinquante [mesures du] pressoir, et il y en avait vingt.
fr.B: quand quelqu’un venait à un tas de grain en comptant sur vingt mesures, il n’y en avait que dix, et quand quelqu’un venait à la cuve pour puiser cinquante mesures, il n’y en avait que vingt.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, quand quelqu’un allait à un tas de grain en comptant y trouver vingt mesures, il n’y en avait que dix. Quand quelqu’un allait à la cuve en comptant puiser cinquante mesures de vin, il n’y en avait que vingt.

es.L: desde entonces, uno venía a un montón de veinte [medidas], y había diez; venía uno al lagar para sacar cincuenta [medidas del] tanque, y había veinte.
es.B: cómo, cuando alguien iba a un montón de grano esperando veinte medidas, solo había diez, y cuando alguien iba al lagar para sacar cincuenta medidas, solo había veinte.
es.R: En aquellos días, cuando alguien iba a un montón de grano esperando veinte medidas, solo había diez. Cuando alguien iba al lagar esperando sacar cincuenta medidas de vino, solo había veinte.

sw.L: tangu siku zile, mtu alipokuja kwenye rundo la [vipimo] ishirini, kulikuwa na kumi; mtu alipokuja kwenye shinikizo la divai kuchota [vipimo] hamsini [kutoka] kwenye kinu, kulikuwa na ishirini.
sw.B: jinsi, mtu alipokuja kwenye rundo la nafaka akitarajia vipimo ishirini, kulikuwa na kumi tu, na mtu alipokuja kwenye shinikizo la divai kuchota vipimo hamsini, kulikuwa na ishirini tu.
sw.R: Siku zile, mtu alipokwenda kwenye rundo la nafaka akitarajia vipimo ishirini, alipata kumi tu. Mtu alipokwenda kwenye shinikizo la divai akitarajia kuchota vipimo hamsini vya divai, alipata ishirini tu.

vi.L: từ những ngày ấy, người ta đến một đống [lúa] hai mươi [đấu], thì chỉ có mười; người ta đến thùng ép rượu để múc năm mươi [đấu từ] bồn ép, thì chỉ có hai mươi.
vi.B: thể nào khi có người đến đống lúa mong được hai mươi đấu, thì chỉ có mười; khi có người đến thùng ép rượu để múc năm mươi đấu, thì chỉ có hai mươi.
vi.R: Trong những ngày ấy, khi có người đến đống lúa mong được hai mươi đấu, thì chỉ có mười. Khi có người đến thùng ép rượu mong múc được năm mươi đấu rượu, thì chỉ có hai mươi.

ko.L: 그때부터, 스무 [섬]을 [바라고] 곡식 더미에 가 보면 열 [섬]뿐이었고, 쉰 [통]을 길으려고 포도주 틀에 가 보면 스무 [통]뿐이었다.
ko.B: 곡식 더미에 가서 스무 섬을 기대했지만 열 섬밖에 없었고, 포도주 통에 가서 쉰 통을 길으려 했지만 스무 통밖에 없었다.
ko.R: 그때에는 곡식 더미에 가서 스무 섬을 기대했지만 열 섬밖에 없었다. 포도주 통에 가서 포도주를 쉰 통 길으려 했지만 스무 통밖에 없었다.

pt.L: desde aqueles dias, alguém vinha a um monte de vinte [medidas], e havia dez; vinha à tina para tirar cinquenta [medidas do] lagar, e havia vinte.
pt.B: como, quando alguém chegava a um monte de cereal esperando vinte medidas, havia só dez, e quando alguém chegava à tina de vinho para tirar cinquenta medidas, havia só vinte.
pt.R: Naquele tempo, quando alguém ia a um monte de cereal esperando vinte medidas, só havia dez. Quando alguém ia à tina de vinho esperando tirar cinquenta medidas de vinho, só havia vinte.

am.L: ከዚያ ዘመን ጀምሮ [አንድ ሰው] ሃያ [መስፈሪያ] ወዳለበት ክምር ይመጣ ነበር፤ አሥርም ይሆን ነበር፤ ከመጭመቂያው ሃምሳ [መስፈሪያ] ሊቀዳ ወደ ወይን መጭመቂያው ጉድጓድ ይመጣ ነበር፤ ሃያም ይሆን ነበር።
am.B: አንድ ሰው ሃያ መስፈሪያ እህል አገኛለሁ ብሎ ወደ ክምሩ ሲመጣ አሥር ብቻ ያገኝ ነበር፤ ሃምሳ መስፈሪያ ሊቀዳ ወደ ወይን መጭመቂያው ጉድጓድ ሲመጣም ሃያ ብቻ ያገኝ ነበር።
am.R: በዚያን ዘመን አንድ ሰው ሃያ መስፈሪያ እህል እንደሚያገኝ ጠብቆ ወደ ክምሩ ሲሄድ የሚያገኘው አሥር ብቻ ነበር። ወደ ወይን መጭመቂያው ጉድጓድም ሃምሳ መስፈሪያ የወይን ጠጅ ለመቅዳት ሲሄድ የሚያገኘው ሃያ ብቻ ነበር።

hi.L: उन दिनों से, जब कोई बीस [नाप] के ढेर के पास आता, तो दस ही होते; जब कोई दाखमधु के कुंड पर कोल्हू में से पचास [नाप] निकालने आता, तो बीस ही होते।
hi.B: कैसे जब कोई अनाज के ढेर के पास बीस नाप की आशा से आता, तो केवल दस होते, और जब कोई दाखमधु के कुंड से पचास नाप निकालने आता, तो केवल बीस होते।
hi.R: उन दिनों जब कोई बीस नाप की आशा से अनाज के ढेर के पास जाता, तो केवल दस नाप मिलते। जब कोई पचास नाप दाखमधु निकालने की आशा से कुंड के पास जाता, तो केवल बीस नाप मिलते।

ru.L: с тех [самых] дней: приходили к куче в двадцать [мер], а было десять; приходили к точилу, чтобы начерпать пятьдесят [мер из] давильни, а было двадцать.
ru.B: как, бывало, придёт человек к куче зерна, ожидая двадцать мер, а их только десять, придёт к винному чану, чтобы начерпать пятьдесят мер, а их только двадцать.
ru.R: В те дни, когда кто-то подходил к куче зерна, ожидая двадцать мер, там было только десять. Когда кто-то подходил к винному чану, надеясь начерпать пятьдесят мер вина, там было только двадцать.

ja.L: その日々の間、人が二十[ます]の山に来ると、十しかなく、搾り場から五十[杯]をくみ出そうと酒ぶねに来ると、二十しかなかった。
ja.B: その頃は、穀物の山に二十ますを期待して行っても十ますしかなく、酒ぶねに五十杯をくみに行っても二十杯しかなかった。
ja.R: そのころは、穀物の山に行って二十ます分を期待しても、十ます分しかなかった。ぶどう酒をためる所に行って、五十杯分をくもうとしても、二十杯分しかなかった。

uk.L: відтоді, як ті [дні] були, приходив хтось до копиці на двадцять [мір], а було десять; приходив до чана, щоб начерпати пʼятдесят [мір із] преса, а було двадцять.
uk.B: як хтось приходив до копиці зерна, чекаючи двадцяти мір, а було лише десять, і як хтось приходив до чана, щоб начерпати пʼятдесят мір, а було лише двадцять.
uk.R: У ті дні, коли хтось ішов до купи зерна, чекаючи двадцяти мір, було лише десять. Коли хтось ішов до чана, сподіваючись начерпати пʼятдесят мір вина, було лише двадцять.

decisions.choice: since those days: through that whole time
decisions.reason: The first word is hard. It may mean "since they were", that is, through all that time. Some suggest a small change to read "how did you fare?". The sense of the verse is plain either way.

decisions.choice: the heap and the wine vat: grain on the threshing floor, wine in the vat below the press
decisions.reason: Threshed grain was piled in a heap on the threshing floor and measured out. Grapes were trodden in a press, and the juice ran into a vat cut in the rock below, from which it was drawn off. The harvests gave half, or less than half, of what was expected. |

decisions.choice: a heap of grain expecting twenty measures (B); only ten (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names only the numbers. Balanced and Readable add "grain", "measures" and "expecting" to make the comparison plain. No unit is named, so none is given. |

decisions.choice: "đấu" for the unnamed measure
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives no unit and the English has no units span; Vietnamese needs a measure word, so the general "đấu" is supplied (bracketed at Literal), with no conversion.

decisions.choice: The unnamed measures are "섬" for grain and "통" for wine (bracketed at L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives only the numbers; Korean needs a counter, and these common measure words name no exact size, as the English "measures" does.

decisions.choice: the unnamed measures as "መስፈሪያ" ([መስፈሪያ] at Literal), with no units span; the wine vat "የወይን መጭመቂያ ጉድጓድ" and the press "መጭመቂያ", as Isaiah 5:2
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives only numbers, so no unit can be converted and the English has no span; "መስፈሪያ" (a measure) supplies what Amharic needs. The vat is the pit below the press, as the meaning decision says, and Isaiah 5:2 on main names it so.

decisions.choice: नाप, without a unit
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names only the numbers. Literal brackets नाप; Balanced and Readable add अनाज, नाप and "expecting" to make the comparison plain, as the English does. No unit is named, so there is no units span.

decisions.choice: The unnamed measures as "ます" for grain and "杯" for wine ([ます], [杯] at L), no units span (the English has none); yeqev "酒ぶね" (L, B), "ぶどう酒をためる所" (R); purah "搾り場" (L).
decisions.reason: Japanese needs a counter; generic counters avoid inventing a unit.

source.text: הִכֵּ֨יתִי אֶתְכֶ֜ם בַּשִּׁדָּפ֤וֹן וּבַיֵּֽרָקוֹן֙ וּבַבָּרָ֔ד אֵ֖ת כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיכֶ֑ם וְאֵין־אֶתְכֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: I struck you with blight and with mildew and with hail, all [the] work of your hands; and not you to me, declaration of Yahweh.

en.L: I struck you with blight and with mildew and with hail, all the work of your hands; yet you [did] not [return] to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I struck you, and all the work of your hands, with blight and mildew and hail, yet you did not return to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I struck your crops with diseases that dried them out and turned them yellow, and I sent hail on all your work. But even then you did not come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Je vous ai frappés par la rouille et par la nielle et par la grêle, tout le travail de vos mains ; et vous n’[êtes] pas [revenus] à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je vous ai frappés, vous et tout le travail de vos mains, par la rouille, la nielle et la grêle, et pourtant vous n’êtes pas revenus à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: J’ai frappé vos récoltes de maladies qui les ont desséchées et jaunies, et j’ai envoyé la grêle sur tout votre travail. Mais même alors, vous n’êtes pas revenus vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} herí con tizón y con añublo y con granizo, toda la obra de {{plural_you:sus manos|vuestras manos}}; pero no [{{plural_you:volvieron|volvisteis}}] a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} herí a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y a toda la obra de {{plural_you:sus manos|vuestras manos}} con tizón, añublo y granizo, pero no {{plural_you:volvieron|volvisteis}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Mandé sobre {{plural_you:sus cosechas|vuestras cosechas}} plagas que las secaban y las ponían amarillas, y envié granizo sobre todo {{plural_you:su trabajo|vuestro trabajo}}. Pero aun así no {{plural_you:regresaron|regresasteis}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Niliwapiga kwa ukungu wa kukausha na kwa ukungu wa kuozesha na kwa mvua ya mawe, kazi yote ya mikono yenu; lakini hamku[nirudia] {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Niliwapiga ninyi, na kazi yote ya mikono yenu, kwa ukungu wa kukausha, kwa ukungu wa kuozesha na kwa mvua ya mawe, lakini hamkunirudia, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Niliyapiga mazao yenu kwa magonjwa yaliyoyakausha na kuyageuza rangi kuwa manjano, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nikaleta mvua ya mawe juu ya kazi yenu yote. Lakini hata hivyo hamkunirudia, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ta đã đánh các ngươi bằng bệnh lúa héo, bằng nấm mốc và bằng mưa đá, cả mọi công việc của tay các ngươi; thế mà các ngươi [vẫn] không [quay về] với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Ta đã đánh các ngươi cùng mọi công việc tay các ngươi làm bằng bệnh lúa héo, nấm mốc và mưa đá, thế mà các ngươi vẫn không quay về với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Ta đã giáng trên mùa màng các ngươi những bệnh làm cho cây khô héo và vàng úa, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sai mưa đá đổ xuống trên mọi công việc của các ngươi. Dù vậy, các ngươi vẫn không quay về với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 내가 마름병과 깜부기병과 우박으로 너희를, 너희 손으로 한 모든 일을 쳤다. 그러나 너희는 나에게 [돌아오지] 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 내가 너희와 너희 손으로 한 모든 일을 마름병과 깜부기병과 우박으로 쳤다. 그래도 너희는 나에게 돌아오지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 나는 너희의 곡식을 병들게 하여, 말라 버리고 누렇게 변하게 했다. 너희가 애써 일한 것 위에 우박을 내렸다. 그래도 너희는 여전히 나에게 돌아오지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Eu feri vocês com crestamento, e com míldio, e com granizo, [em] todo o trabalho das suas mãos; mas vocês não [voltaram] para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Eu feri vocês, e todo o trabalho das suas mãos, com crestamento, míldio e granizo. Mesmo assim vocês não voltaram para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Eu castiguei as suas plantações com doenças que as secaram e as deixaram amarelas, e mandei granizo sobre todo o trabalho de vocês. Mas mesmo assim vocês não voltaram para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: በዋግና በሻጋታ በበረዶም መታኋችሁ፤ የእጃችሁንም ሥራ ሁሉ [መታሁ]፤ እናንተ ግን ወደ እኔ [አልተመለሳችሁም]፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: እናንተንና የእጃችሁን ሥራ ሁሉ በዋግ፣ በሻጋታና በበረዶ መታሁ፤ ያም ሆኖ ወደ እኔ አልተመለሳችሁም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ሰብላችሁን በሚያደርቅና በሚያገረጣ በሽታ መታሁ፤ በሥራችሁም ሁሉ ላይ በረዶ አወረድኩ። ያም ሆኖ እንኳ ወደ እኔ አልተመለሳችሁም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: मैंने तुम्हें, तुम्हारे हाथों के सारे काम को, झुलसा से और गेरुई से और ओलों से मारा; फिर भी तुम मेरी ओर [न लौटे], {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: मैंने तुम्हें और तुम्हारे हाथों के सारे काम को झुलसा, गेरुई और ओलों से मारा, फिर भी तुम मेरी ओर न लौटे, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: मैंने तुम्हारी फ़सलों पर ऐसे रोग भेजे जिनसे वे सूख गईं और पीली पड़ गईं, और मैंने तुम्हारे सारे काम पर ओले बरसाए। फिर भी तुम मेरे पास नहीं लौटे, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: Я поразил вас палящим ветром, и ржавчиной, и градом — весь труд ваших рук; но вы не [вернулись] ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Я поразил вас и весь труд ваших рук палящим ветром, ржавчиной и градом, но вы не вернулись ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Я наслал на ваши посевы болезни, от которых они засыхали и желтели, и послал град на всю вашу работу. Но даже тогда вы не вернулись ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: わたしは立ち枯れとさび病と雹で、あなたがたを、あなたがたの手のすべての業を打った。しかし、あなたがたはわたしのもとに[立ち帰ら]なかった。――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――
ja.B: わたしは、あなたがたとあなたがたの手のすべての業を、立ち枯れとさび病と雹で打った。それでも、あなたがたはわたしに立ち帰らなかった、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: わたしは、作物を枯らし、黄色くする病気で、あなたたちの作物を打ち、あなたたちのすべての働きの上にひょうを降らせた。それでも、あなたたちは、わたしのもとに立ち帰ろうとしなかった、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

uk.L: Я вразив вас посухою, і іржею, і градом, усю працю ваших рук; але ви [не повернулися] до {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Я вразив вас і всю працю ваших рук посухою, іржею і градом, але ви не повернулися до {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Я вразив ваші посіви хворобами, від яких вони всихали й жовкли, і послав град на всю вашу працю. Але й тоді ви не повернулися до {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: blight and mildew ... yet you did not return to me: the words of Amos 4:9
decisions.reason: Amos 4:9 has "I struck you with blight and with mildew ... yet you did not return to me, declares the LORD". The plagues are among the curses of the covenant (Deuteronomy 28:22; 1 Kings 8:37). Haggai applies the old words to his own day. |

decisions.choice: not you to me: you did not turn to me
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is very short, "and not you to me", with no verb. The words of Amos 4:9 show the sense: "you did not return to me". The Greek translation is generally said to read "you did not return to me" here too.

decisions.choice: blight and mildew: crop diseases
decisions.reason: The first word means scorching, as by the hot east wind; the second a yellowing of the grain, a kind of mildew or rust. Hail beat down crops and vines (Exodus 9:25). |

decisions.choice: the wording of Amos 4:9 at each level
decisions.reason: Where Haggai uses the words of Amos 4:9, each level uses the wording published there: "blight and with mildew ... yet you did not return to me" (L, B) and "diseases that dried them out and turned them yellow ... But even then you did not come back to me" (R). Literal brackets the words the Hebrew leaves out. |

decisions.choice: the Spanish wording of Amos 4:9 at each level
decisions.reason: Haggai takes up Amos 4:9 ("tizón", "añublo", "no volvieron a mí"), and the Spanish reuses those words at each level, adding the hail.

decisions.choice: the Vietnamese wording of Amos 4:9 at each level ("bệnh lúa héo và nấm mốc"; "không quay về với Ta")
decisions.reason: The English reuses Amos 4:9 for the shared words; so does the Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: The Korean Amos 4:9 wording at each level ("마름병과 깜부기병" L, B; "말라 버리고 누렇게 변하게" R; "나에게 돌아오지 않았다")
decisions.reason: Haggai repeats Amos 4:9, so the published Korean is reused; the Hebrew here has no verb in "not you to me", which Literal brackets.

decisions.choice: "la rouille et la nielle" (L, B) for blight and mildew, and the refrain "vous n’êtes pas revenus à moi" (L, B) / "vous n’êtes pas revenus vers moi" (R), as the French of Amos 4:9; "revenir" for the supplied verb
decisions.reason: Haggai repeats the words of Amos 4:9 (the English meaning decision), so each level uses the French of Amos 4:9: "rouille" and "nielle", the usual French names for scorching blight and yellowing mildew, at L and B, the same description of the diseases at R, and the same refrain; the missing verb is *shuv*, "revenir", as the prophets.

decisions.choice: "hamku[nirudia] mimi" (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no verb ("and not you to me"); Swahili needs one, so "[nirudia]" is bracketed while the negative prefix "hamku-" carries the Hebrew "not you".

decisions.choice: the Portuguese of Amos 4:9 at each level: Eu feri vocês com crestamento e com míldio ... vocês não voltaram para mim
decisions.reason: Haggai repeats Amos 4:9 (m1), and Amos's Portuguese set these words for both: "crestamento" and "míldio" (L, B), as Deuteronomy 28:22 has them, "doenças que as secaram e as deixaram amarelas" (R), and "mesmo assim vocês não voltaram para mim". Literal brackets the verb that the short Hebrew leaves out (m2).

decisions.choice: the wording of Amos 4:9 on main at each level: blight and mildew "ዋግና ሻጋታ" (L, B), "በሚያደርቅና በሚያገረጣ በሽታ" (R); "ወደ እኔ አልተመለሳችሁም" with "ያም ሆኖ" (B) and "ያም ሆኖ እንኳ" (R); hail "በረዶ"
decisions.reason: Haggai takes up Amos 4:9 (the meaning decision), so the shared words read as they do there. The Hebrew has no verb in "not you to me"; Literal brackets the whole verb "[አልተመለሳችሁም]", as the English brackets [did] [return], and the second "[መታሁ]" that Amharic needs for the work of their hands.

decisions.choice: झुलसा, गेरुई; फिर भी तुम मेरी ओर न लौटे (L, B), मेरे पास नहीं लौटे (R)
decisions.reason: Haggai uses the words of Amos 4:9 (m1), so each level keeps the Hindi of Amos 4:9: blight and mildew are झुलसा and गेरुई (m3), as there and in 2 Chronicles 6:28, and "yet you did not return to me" is फिर भी तुम मेरी ओर न लौटे (L, B), मेरे पास नहीं लौटे (R). Readable says what blight and mildew do, in Amos' words.

decisions.choice: "палящий ветер" and "ржавчина" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The two crop diseases in the Russian forms of Deuteronomy 28:22. The line repeats Amos 4:9 (m1), so Amos 4:9 has the same words, and Readable takes Amos's "Я наслал на ваши посевы болезни, от которых они засыхали и желтели".

decisions.choice: The wording of Amos 4:9 at each level: shiddafon veyeraqon "立ち枯れとさび病" (L, B), R "作物を枯らし、黄色くする病気", and the refrain "わたしのもとに立ち帰らなかった"; barad "雹" (L, B), "ひょう" (R).
decisions.reason: The meaning decision marks the allusion; the Japanese of Amos is reused.

source.text: שִׂימוּ־נָ֣א לְבַבְכֶ֔ם מִן־הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה מִיּוֹם֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֜ה לַתְּשִׁיעִ֗י לְמִן־הַיּ֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יֻסַּ֥ד הֵֽיכַל־יְהוָ֖ה שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Set, please, your heart from this day and upward, from [the] twenty-fourth day of the ninth, from the day that [the] temple of Yahweh was founded; set your heart:

en.L: Set your heart, please, from this day and onward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth [month], from the day that the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was founded; set your heart:
en.B: Think carefully from this day on, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, from the day the foundation of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple was laid. Think carefully:
en.R: Think carefully about what will happen from today on. Today is the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month. Today the foundation of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple has been laid. Think about it.

fr.L: Mettez donc votre cœur [à considérer], depuis ce jour et au-delà, depuis le vingt-quatrième jour du neuvième [mois], depuis le jour où le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} a été fondé ; mettez votre cœur [à considérer] :
fr.B: Réfléchissez bien à partir de ce jour, à partir du vingt-quatrième jour du neuvième mois, du jour où les fondations du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ont été posées. Réfléchissez bien :
fr.R: Réfléchissez bien à ce qui va se passer à partir d’aujourd’hui. Nous sommes le vingt-quatrième jour du neuvième mois. Aujourd’hui, les fondations du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ont été posées. Pensez-y.

es.L: {{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}}, por favor, {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}} desde este día en adelante, desde el día veinticuatro del [mes] noveno, desde el día en que se pusieron los cimientos del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; {{plural_you:pongan su corazón|poned vuestro corazón}}:
es.B: {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} bien desde este día en adelante, desde el día veinticuatro del mes noveno, desde el día en que se pusieron los cimientos del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} bien:
es.R: {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} bien en lo que pasará de hoy en adelante. Hoy es el día veinticuatro del noveno mes. Hoy se han puesto los cimientos del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Piénsenlo|Pensadlo}}.

sw.L: Wekeni mioyo yenu, tafadhali, tangu siku hii na kuendelea, tangu siku ya ishirini na nne ya [mwezi wa] tisa, tangu siku ambayo msingi wa hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulipowekwa; wekeni mioyo yenu:
sw.B: Fikirini kwa makini tangu siku hii na kuendelea, tangu siku ya ishirini na nne ya mwezi wa tisa, tangu siku msingi wa hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulipowekwa. Fikirini kwa makini:
sw.R: Fikirini kwa makini yatakayotokea tangu leo na kuendelea. Leo ni siku ya ishirini na nne ya mwezi wa tisa. Leo msingi wa hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} umewekwa. Fikirini jambo hili.

vi.L: Xin hãy để lòng từ ngày này trở đi, từ ngày hai mươi bốn tháng thứ chín, từ ngày nền đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} được đặt; hãy để lòng:
vi.B: Hãy suy xét kỹ từ ngày này trở đi, từ ngày hai mươi bốn tháng chín, từ ngày nền đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} được đặt. Hãy suy xét kỹ:
vi.R: Hãy suy nghĩ kỹ về những gì sẽ xảy ra từ hôm nay trở đi. Hôm nay là ngày hai mươi bốn tháng chín. Hôm nay nền đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã được đặt. Hãy suy nghĩ về điều đó.

ko.L: 이제 이날부터 이후를 너희 마음에 두어라. 아홉째 [달] 이십사일부터, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전의 기초를 놓은 날부터 너희 마음에 두어라.
ko.B: 오늘부터 앞으로를 깊이 생각해 보아라. 아홉째 달 이십사일, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 기초를 놓은 이날부터 깊이 생각해 보아라.
ko.R: 오늘부터 앞으로 어떤 일이 일어날지 잘 생각해 보아라. 오늘은 아홉째 달 24일이다. 오늘 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 기초를 놓았다. 잘 생각해 보아라.

pt.L: Ponham o coração, por favor, deste dia em diante, desde o vigésimo quarto dia do nono [mês], desde o dia em que foi fundado o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; ponham o coração:
pt.B: Considerem bem, deste dia em diante, desde o vigésimo quarto dia do nono mês, desde o dia em que foram lançados os alicerces do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Considerem bem:
pt.R: Pensem bem no que vai acontecer de hoje em diante. Hoje é o dia vinte e quatro do nono mês. Hoje foram lançados os alicerces do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Pensem nisso.

am.L: እባካችሁ፣ ከዚህ ቀን ጀምሮ ወደ ፊት፣ ከዘጠነኛው [ወር] ከሃያ አራተኛው ቀን ጀምሮ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} መቅደስ ከተመሠረተበት ቀን ጀምሮ ልባችሁን [በዚህ ላይ] አድርጉ፤ ልባችሁን [በዚህ ላይ] አድርጉ፦
am.B: ከዚህ ቀን ጀምሮ፣ ከዘጠነኛው ወር ከሃያ አራተኛው ቀን ጀምሮ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ መሠረት ከተጣለበት ቀን ጀምሮ በጥንቃቄ አስቡ። በጥንቃቄ አስቡ፦
am.R: ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ምን እንደሚሆን በጥንቃቄ አስቡ። ዛሬ የዘጠነኛው ወር ሃያ አራተኛ ቀን ነው። ዛሬ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ መሠረት ተጥሏል። ይህን አስቡ።

hi.L: आज के दिन से आगे की ओर अपना मन लगाओ, नौवें [महीने] के चौबीसवें दिन से, उस दिन से जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मन्दिर की नींव डाली गई; अपना मन लगाओ:
hi.B: आज के दिन से आगे ध्यान से सोचो, नौवें महीने के चौबीसवें दिन से, उस दिन से जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मन्दिर की नींव डाली गई। ध्यान से सोचो:
hi.R: अब ध्यान से सोचो कि आज से आगे क्या होगा। आज नौवें महीने का चौबीसवाँ दिन है। आज {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मन्दिर की नींव डाली गई है। इस पर सोचो।

ru.L: Обратите же ваше сердце с этого дня и далее, с двадцать четвёртого дня девятого [месяца], с того дня, как был основан храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}; обратите ваше сердце:
ru.B: Задумайтесь о том, что будет с этого дня, с двадцать четвёртого дня девятого месяца, с того дня, когда было положено основание храма {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Задумайтесь:
ru.R: Подумайте хорошенько о том, что будет с сегодняшнего дня. Сегодня двадцать четвёртый день девятого месяца. Сегодня положено основание храма {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Подумайте об этом.

ja.L: どうか、この日から以後、あなたがたの心を置け。第九[の月]の二十四日から、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿の基が据えられた日から、あなたがたの心を置け。
ja.B: この日から先のことを、よく考えなさい。第九の月の二十四日、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿の基礎が据えられたこの日から先のことを。よく考えなさい。
ja.R: 今日から何が起こるかを、よく考えなさい。今日は第九の月の二十四日だ。今日、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿の土台が据えられた。よく考えなさい。

uk.L: Покладіть, прошу, ваше серце від цього дня й далі, від двадцять четвертого дня девʼятого [місяця], від дня, коли закладено храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}; покладіть ваше серце:
uk.B: Подумайте добре від цього дня й далі, від двадцять четвертого дня девʼятого місяця, від дня, коли закладено основу храму {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Подумайте добре:
uk.R: Подумайте добре, що буде від сьогодні. Сьогодні двадцять четвертий день девʼятого місяця. Сьогодні закладено основу храму {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Подумайте про це.

decisions.choice: the day that the temple of the LORD was founded: this very day
alternatives: the day of the first foundation in 536 BC
decisions.reason: The foundation of the second temple was first laid soon after the exiles returned (Ezra 3:10). Here "the day that the temple was founded" is this day, the twenty-fourth of the ninth month, so the words probably refer to a ceremony of laying the foundation anew, or to the formal restart of the work.

decisions.choice: from this day and onward: now looking forward
decisions.reason: In verse 15 the phrase looked back. Here it looks ahead: from this day the LORD will bless (verse 19).

decisions.choice: set your heart (L), think carefully (B, R)
decisions.reason: The call keeps the wording of 1:5 at each level. |

decisions.choice: "hãy để lòng" (L) / "hãy suy xét kỹ" (B) / "hãy suy nghĩ kỹ" (R) for "set your heart", as in 1:5
decisions.reason: One wording per level for this repeated phrase through Haggai.

decisions.choice: "from this day and onward" as "ከዚህ ቀን ጀምሮ ወደ ፊት" (L); set your heart "ልባችሁን [በዚህ ላይ] አድርጉ" (L) and "በጥንቃቄ አስቡ" (B, R), as 1:5 and 2:15; was founded "ተመሠረተ" (L), "መሠረት ተጣለ" (B, R), as Ezra 3:6
decisions.reason: Here the phrase looks forward (the meaning decision), so Literal turns from "ወደ ኋላ" in 2:15 to "ወደ ፊት". The refrain keeps one wording at each level, and the founding of the temple keeps the words of Ezra 3 on main.

source.text: הַע֤וֹד הַזֶּ֨רַע֙ בַּמְּגוּרָ֔ה וְעַד־הַגֶּ֨פֶן וְהַתְּאֵנָ֧ה וְהָרִמּ֛וֹן וְעֵ֥ץ הַזַּ֖יִת לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֑א מִן־הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה אֲבָרֵֽךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: [Is] the seed still in the granary? And even the vine and the fig tree and the pomegranate and the olive tree have not borne. From this day I will bless.

en.L: Is the seed still in the storehouse? And even the vine and the fig and the pomegranate and the olive tree have not borne [fruit]. From this day I will bless [you].
en.B: Is there still any seed left in the barn? Even the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate and the olive tree have not yet borne fruit. But from this day on I will bless you.
en.R: Is any seed left in the barn? The grapevines, fig trees, pomegranate trees and olive trees have not produced any fruit yet. But from today on I will bless you.

fr.L: La semence est-elle encore dans le grenier ? Et même la vigne et le figuier et le grenadier et l’olivier n’ont pas porté [de fruit]. Dès ce jour je [vous] bénirai.
fr.B: Reste-t-il encore de la semence dans le grenier ? Même la vigne, le figuier, le grenadier et l’olivier n’ont pas encore porté de fruit. Mais à partir de ce jour, je vous bénirai.
fr.R: Reste-t-il de la semence dans le grenier ? Les vignes, les figuiers, les grenadiers et les oliviers n’ont pas encore donné de fruits. Mais à partir d’aujourd’hui, je vous bénirai.

es.L: ¿Está todavía la semilla en el granero? Y aun la vid, y la higuera, y el granado, y el olivo no han dado [fruto]. Desde este día [{{plural_you:los|os}}] bendeciré.
es.B: ¿Queda todavía semilla en el granero? Ni la vid, ni la higuera, ni el granado, ni el olivo han dado fruto todavía. Pero desde este día {{plural_you:los|os}} bendeciré.
es.R: ¿Queda alguna semilla en el granero? Las vides, las higueras, los granados y los olivos todavía no han dado fruto. Pero desde hoy {{plural_you:los|os}} bendeciré.

sw.L: Je, mbegu bado iko ghalani? Na hata mzabibu na mtini na mkomamanga na mzeituni haijazaa [matunda]. Tangu siku hii nitawabariki.
sw.B: Je, bado kuna mbegu iliyobaki ghalani? Hata mzabibu, mtini, mkomamanga na mzeituni bado haijazaa matunda. Lakini tangu siku hii nitawabariki.
sw.R: Je, kuna mbegu yoyote iliyobaki ghalani? Mizabibu, mitini, mikomamanga na mizeituni bado haijazaa matunda. Lakini tangu leo nitawabariki.

vi.L: Hạt giống còn trong kho chăng? Ngay cả cây nho, cây vả, cây lựu và cây ô-liu cũng chưa ra [trái]. Từ ngày này {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban phước [cho các ngươi].
vi.B: Còn hạt giống nào trong kho nữa không? Ngay cả cây nho, cây vả, cây lựu và cây ô-liu cũng chưa ra trái. Nhưng từ ngày này trở đi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban phước cho các ngươi.
vi.R: Có còn hạt giống nào trong kho không? Cây nho, cây vả, cây lựu và cây ô-liu chưa ra trái. Nhưng từ hôm nay trở đi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban phước cho các ngươi.

ko.L: 씨앗이 아직 곳간에 있느냐? 포도나무와 무화과나무와 석류나무와 올리브나무도 아직 [열매를] 맺지 못했다. 이날부터 내가 [너희에게] 복을 주겠다.
ko.B: 곳간에 아직 씨앗이 남아 있느냐? 포도나무와 무화과나무와 석류나무와 올리브나무도 아직 열매를 맺지 못했다. 그러나 이날부터 내가 너희에게 복을 주겠다.
ko.R: 곳간에 씨앗이 남아 있느냐? 포도나무와 무화과나무와 석류나무와 올리브나무에 아직 열매가 하나도 열리지 않았다. 그러나 오늘부터 내가 너희에게 복을 주겠다.

pt.L: Ainda [há] semente no celeiro? E até a videira, e a figueira, e a romãzeira, e a oliveira não deram [fruto]. Deste dia [em diante] abençoarei [vocês].
pt.B: Ainda resta alguma semente no celeiro? Nem a videira, nem a figueira, nem a romãzeira, nem a oliveira deram fruto ainda. Mas deste dia em diante eu abençoarei vocês.
pt.R: Ainda sobrou alguma semente no celeiro? As videiras, as figueiras, as romãzeiras e as oliveiras ainda não deram nenhum fruto. Mas de hoje em diante eu vou abençoar vocês.

am.L: ዘሩ ገና በጎተራ ውስጥ ነውን? ወይኑና በለሱ፣ ሮማኑና የወይራ ዛፉም እንኳ [ፍሬ] አላፈሩም፤ ከዚህ ቀን ጀምሮ [እናንተን] እባርካለሁ።
am.B: ዘር አሁንም በጎተራ ውስጥ ቀርቷልን? ወይኑ፣ በለሱ፣ ሮማኑና የወይራ ዛፉ እንኳ ገና ፍሬ አላፈሩም። ከዚህ ቀን ጀምሮ ግን እባርካችኋለሁ።
am.R: በጎተራ ውስጥ የቀረ ዘር አለን? የወይን ተክሎቹ፣ የበለስ ዛፎቹ፣ የሮማን ዛፎቹና የወይራ ዛፎቹ ገና ምንም ፍሬ አላፈሩም። ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ግን እባርካችኋለሁ።

hi.L: क्या बीज अब तक खत्ते में है? और दाखलता और अंजीर और अनार और जैतून के पेड़ ने अब तक [फल] नहीं दिया। आज के दिन से मैं [तुम्हें] आशीष दूँगा।
hi.B: क्या खत्ते में अब भी कुछ बीज बचा है? दाखलता, अंजीर, अनार और जैतून के पेड़ ने अब तक फल नहीं दिया है। पर आज के दिन से मैं तुम्हें आशीष दूँगा।
hi.R: क्या खत्ते में कुछ बीज बचा है? अंगूर की लताओं, अंजीर, अनार और जैतून के पेड़ों पर अब तक कोई फल नहीं लगा है। पर आज से मैं तुम्हें आशीष दूँगा।

ru.L: Есть ли ещё семя в житнице? И даже виноградная лоза, и смоковница, и гранатовое дерево, и маслина не принесли [плода]. С этого дня {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} благословлю [вас].
ru.B: Осталось ли ещё семя в амбаре? Даже виноградная лоза, смоковница, гранатовое дерево и маслина ещё не принесли плода. Но с этого дня {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} благословлю вас.
ru.R: Осталось ли в амбаре зерно для посева? Виноградные лозы, инжировые деревья, гранатовые и оливковые деревья ещё не дали плодов. Но с сегодняшнего дня {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду благословлять вас.

ja.L: 種はまだ倉にあるか？ぶどうの木も、いちじくも、ざくろも、オリーブの木も、[実を]結んでいない。この日から、わたしは[あなたがたを]祝福する。
ja.B: 種はまだ倉に残っているだろうか？ぶどうの木も、いちじくの木も、ざくろの木も、オリーブの木も、まだ実を結んでいない。しかし、この日から、わたしはあなたがたを祝福する。
ja.R: 倉に種が残っているだろうか？ぶどうの木も、いちじくの木も、ざくろの木も、オリーブの木も、まだ実をつけていない。しかし今日から、わたしはあなたたちを祝福する。

uk.L: Чи ще є насіння в коморі? І навіть виноградна лоза, і смоковниця, і гранат, і оливкове дерево не дали [плоду]. Від цього дня {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} благословлятиму [вас].
uk.B: Чи залишилося ще насіння в коморі? Навіть виноградна лоза, смоковниця, гранат і оливкове дерево ще не дали плоду. Але від цього дня {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} благословлятиму вас.
uk.R: Чи залишилося ще якесь насіння в коморі? Виноградні лози, смоковниці, гранатові дерева й оливки ще не дали жодного плоду. Але від сьогодні {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} благословлятиму вас.

decisions.choice: the seed, the vine, the fig, the pomegranate, the olive: the harvests still to come
decisions.reason: By the ninth month the winter seed had been sown, so none was left in the storehouse, and the fruit trees would not bear until the summer. Nothing could yet be seen of the coming harvest. The LORD promises the blessing before there is any sign of it. |

decisions.choice: I will bless: I will give you good harvests
decisions.reason: The verb has no object in the Hebrew; the people and their harvests are meant (compare Deuteronomy 28:8). |

decisions.choice: [fruit], [you] (L); fruit, you (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew leaves out what the trees bear and whom the LORD will bless. |

decisions.choice: "смоковница" (L, B); "инжировые деревья" (R)
